[00:01:02] Razavi: Hamara aqeedah aur nazariya yehi hai Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka, hamare akabir-e-salaf ka, salaf saliheen ka. [00:01:48] Razavi: Kuch arsa pehle hi maine is par baat ki thi ke Surah An-Naml ki ayat number 40 mein jo Hazrat Asif bin Barkhiya ka waqia Allah Rabbul Izzat ne Quran mein bayan kiya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah An-Naml ayat 40"). Hazrat Sulayman alayhis salam ne farmaya malka Bilqis ka takht kaun le kar aayega? Asif bin Barkhiya ne kaha: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Aana aateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuk"). Main aapki bargah mein takht-e-Bilqis le kar aaonga aapki aankh jhapakhne se pehle.
[00:02:24] Razavi: Ab takht-e-Bilqis lane wale kaun the? Sulayman alayhis salam ke munshi Asif bin Barkhiya the. Sawal ye paida hota hai ke ye unhon ne apni jismani taqat se wo laye hain ya roohani taqat se? Yemen se aankh jhapakhne se pehle takht hazir kar diya. Ye jismani taqat nahi, ye Allah Rabbul Izzat ne jo apne mehboob bandon ko roohani taqat di hai, ye roohani taqat se le kar aaye.
[00:03:02] Razavi: Aur wo roohani taqat Allah ka mehboob banda chahe zinda ho tab bhi Allah ki taraf se unko hai, aur agar wo duniya se parda kar jayein toh unki rooh ki taqat ab bhi maujood hai. Maut jism par taari hoti hai, rooh par maut taari nahi hoti. Rooh toh momin ki zinda hai.
[00:03:49] Razavi: Ab Allah ke mehboob bandon se jo istimdad ya istighatha ya madad talab ki jati hai is aqeedah ke sath, is niyat ke sath ke Allah Rabbul Izzat ki di hui taqat se inki rooh meri madad kar sakti hai, toh ye shirk hargiz nahi hai. Baqi raha istemal waseele ka, toh waseele ke sath unka sadqa-waseela de kar dua ki jaye toh yaqeenan ye jaiz aur mustahabb hai, isko hum farz aur wajib nahi samajhte.
[00:04:27] Q: Doosra mas'ala ye hai ke waseela toh dua mein ho gaya. [00:04:58] Razavi: Jee, iska jawab ye hai ke dua ka matlab kya hai? Dua ka ma'ana kya hai? Agar dua mehaz kisi ko pukaarne ko ya kisi ke bulane ko dua kehte hain aur isko ibadat thehrate hain, toh ye toh Quran aur Hadith ke khilaf hai.
[00:05:14] Razavi: Misal ke taur par Quran-e-Majeed mein Allah Rabbul Izzat ne jahan Sahaba-e-Kiram ke hawale se farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Aal-e-Imran, wa rasoolu yad'ookum fee ukhraakum"). Aur Rasool tumhe tumhare doosre giroh mein pukaar rahe the. [00:06:29] Razavi: Surah An-Nur mein ayat number 63 hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah An-Nur ayat 63, La taj'aloo du'a ar-rasooli baynakum ka-du'ai ba'dikum ba'da"). Yahan bhi kalma-e-dua zikr hua. Yahan dua mehaz pukaarna aur bulana hai, ibadat nahi hai.
[00:08:00] Razavi: Ab ye jo hadith hai 'ad-du'a huwal ibadah', muhadditheen ki sharhaat utha ke dekh lein. 'Ad-du'a' ke shuru mein alif-laam hai. Ye alif-laam ahd ka hai. Ma'ana ye hai: 'ad-du'a-ullah huwal ibadah' — yani jab momin banda Allah ko pukaare toh Allah ko pukaarna ibadat hai. Kyunke jab banda apne Rabb ko pukaarta hai toh usko apna Ma'bud aur Ilah samajh kar pukaarta hai. Jab banda kisi ko apna Ma'bud samajh kar pukaarega toh wo pukaarna ibadat hoga. [00:09:40] Razavi: Surah Al-Baqarah mein Hazrat Ibrahim alayhis salam ko Allah ne farmaya parindon ke tukde kar ke pahadon par rakh dein, phir: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Baqarah, thumma ud'uhunna ya'teenaka sa'ya"). Ibrahim alayhis salam ne un murda parindon ko pukaara, toh kya murda parindon ko pukaarna ibadat tha?
[00:10:45] Razavi: Hadith-e-hasan hai jisko Hafiz Ibn Kathir ne Al-Bidayah wan-Nihayah mein aur ghair-muqallideen ke Nasiruddin Albani ne sahih qarar diya: Hazrat Umar radiyallahu anhu ne minbar par baithe hue pukaara: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Ya Sariyah al-jabal"). Madina se Nahawand door baithe pukaara. Kya ye pukaarna shirk tha?
[00:11:48] Razavi: Imam Bukhari ne Al-Adab al-Mufrad mein, Imam Ibn Sa'd ne, aur Imam Nawawi ne Kitab al-Adhkar mein darj kiya: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar radiyallahu anhu ka paon sunn ho gaya toh unhein kaha gaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Ud'u ahabba an-nasi ilayk"). Unhon ne pukaara: 'Ya Muhammad'.
[00:12:45] Razavi: Namaz mein khade hona ibadat hai, lekin ustad aur waldain ke ahtiram mein khada hona ta'zeem hai. Namaz mein qa'dah mein baithna ibadat hai, lekin ustad ya peer ke samne do-zanu baithna ta'zeem hai, jaise Hadith-e-Jibril mein Jibril alayhis salam Huzoor ﷺ ke samne baithe. Isi tarah Allah ko pukaarna ibadat hai, aur bande ko Allah ki ata aur waseela samajh kar pukaarna ta'zeem aur istimdad hai, shirk nahi.

## Transcript

[00:00:12] Razavi: Anbiya alayhimus salatu wat-tasleemat aur auliya Allah rahimahumullah se istimdad aur madad maangne ke hawale se Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke mukhalifeen ki taraf se Ahl-e-Sunnat par shirk aur kufr ka fatwa lagaya jata hai...
[00:01:00] Razavi: Tamheedi taur par ye baatein samajhna zaroori hai ke hamare Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke aqeedah ke mutabiq haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar Allah Rabbul Izzat ki zaat hai. Jo Allah ke ilawa kisi aur ko haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar samjhe wo mushrik hai.
[00:01:25] Razavi: Surah Al-Fatiha ke andar jo hai 'Iyyaaka Na'budu wa Iyyaaka Nasta'een', is mein hasr-e-haqeeqi hai. Hasr-e-mutlaq nahi hai. Yani haqeeqat mein aye Allah hum tujh hi se madad chahte hain.
[00:02:00] Razavi: Haan Allah Rabbul Izzat ke anbiya, auliya ya Allah ki makhlooq... qabl az wafat ya ba'd az wafat, zinda hon ya faut-shuda hon, qareeb se hon ya door se hon... unko haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar nahi samjha jata balkay unhein Allah ki madad ka mazhar, Allah ki aan ka mazhar aur zariya samjha jata hai.
[00:04:20] Razavi: Ek hadith-e-mubaraka ka hawala de kar ye sabit kiya jata hai ke Allah ke ilawa kisi aur ko pukaarna shirk hai: 'ad-du'a huwal ibadah' — dua ibadat hai, ma'ana pukaarna ibadat hai... Halankay is hadith ka ye matlab nahi balkay hadith ka matlab hai 'ad-du'a-ullah huwal ibadah' — Allah ko pukaarna, Allah se dua karna ye ibadat hai.
[00:07:50] Razavi: Ab is tamheed ke baad jab hum Quran-o-Sunnat se ye cheezein bayan karte hain toh hamare mukhalifeen apni taraf se wo quyood-o-sharaait badhate jate hain ke kisi na kisi tarah Musalmanon ko mushrik qarar diya jaye.
[00:08:08] Razavi: Hum jab kehte hain ke bhai Allah Rabbul Izzat ke bandon ko pukaarna mutlaqan shirk nahi hai, toh phir mukhalifeen aur bilkhusoos Jhelumi aur uske followers wo kehte hain: nahi jee, ghaib se pukaarna shirk hai! Halankay Quran Majeed ki ayat ke andar ghaib ki condition nahi hai, ghaib ki koi shart nahi hai. 'Iyyaaka Nasta'een' mein ghaib-o-hazir ki baat nahi, zindagi aur wafat ki baat nahi.
[00:08:34] Razavi: Kabhi kehte hain ke hazir se maangna shirk nahi ghaib se maangna shirk hai. Kabhi kehte hain ke ma taht al-asbab maangna shirk nahi ma fawq al-asbab maangna shirk hai... Hum kehte hain ke shirk tab hoga kisi se madad maangna jab kisi ko apna ilah samajh kar, ma'bud samajh kar us se istimdad aur istighatha kiya jaye tab shirk hai! Jab bande ko banda samajh kar, Allah ki makhlooq samajh kar us se istimdad ki jaye aur usey haqeeqi madadgaar nahi balkay Allah ki madad ka zariya samajh kar madad maangi jaye toh wo shirk nahi hai.
[00:10:43] Razavi: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah ke andar hadith 30339 hai, Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu anhuma farmate hain: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Inna lillahi mala'ikatan fidd-ard... fa-l-yunadi: a'eenu 'ibadAllah rahimakumullah"). Aye Allah ke bandon meri madad karo, Allah tum par rahm farmaye.
[00:11:42] Razavi: Is hadith ko Imam Haythami ne Majma al-Zawa'id jild 10 safha 188 pe 17104 number marfoo'an zikr kiya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Rawaahu al-Bazzar wa rijaaluhu thiaat"). Imam Bazzar ne Musnad mein zikr kiya aur farmaya iske tamaam rijaal thiqah hain.
[00:13:00] Razavi: Nasiruddin Albani ne Silsilat al-Ahadith al-Da'ifah wal-Mawdu'ah mein is par likha ke Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne is hadith ko hasan qarar diya hai, Imam Sakhawi ne Al-Ibtihaj mein hasan qarar diya hai, aur aakhir mein Albani ne kaha: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Qultu wa haadha isnaduhu hasan kama qaloo").
[00:14:02] Razavi: Aur iske mutabi'at aur shawahid hain: Imam Tabarani Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir mein 13737 Utba bin Ghazwan se marfoo'an laye: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Ya 'IbadAllah agheesoonee"). Farmaya: aise Allah ke bande hain jinhein hum dekhte nahi, wo uski madad kar dete hain. Imam Tabarani farmate hain: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Wa qad jurriba dhalik") — iska tajurba kiya gaya hai.

## Transcript

[00:00:10] Mirza: Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat number 35: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Ma'idah ayat 35, Yaa ayyuhallazeena aamanuttaqullaha wabtaghoo ilayhil waseelata"). Ye subcontinent mein ek aisi ayat hai jis ke upar poore ke poore firqe khade hain. Aur wo kehte hain Quran mein Allah ne hukm de diya ke waseela talash karna hai...
[00:01:05] Mirza: Waseela purely Arbi ka lafz hai, iska Punjabi waseele ke sath koi lena dena nahi hai. Yahan Barelvi, Deobandi jo dominant firqe hain, inka waseela ye hai ke ye samajhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala tak direct nahi pohncha ja sakta, toh buzurgan-e-deen ko beech mein daal diya jaye. Aur misal dete hain chat ki: chat par aap direct nahi pohnch sakte, seedhi (ladder) ke zariye pohnchein ge.
[00:03:50] Mirza: Mere bhai, chat par jane ke liye seedhi ki zaroorat hai, lekin Allah tak pohnchne ke liye kisi seedhi ki zaroorat nahi hai! Kyunke Allah ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Baqarah ayat 186, Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibaadee 'annee fa-innee qareeb, ujeebu da'watad-da'i idha da'aan"). Jab mere bande mere baare mein poochein toh farma dein main bilkul qareeb hoon, pukaarne wale ki pukaar ko sunta hoon.
[00:07:20] Mirza: Doctor Israr Ahmed sahab farmate the ke insaniyat ka Magna Carta Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat number 186 hai... Direct rab se maango.
[00:09:10] Mirza: Yahan waseela aur istighatha ko mix kar diya gaya hai. Hamari zubaan mein waseela hai ke koi kahe: 'Aye Allah, tujhe tere Nabi ka wasita, mera falan kaam kar de'. Is mein aapne insaan se kuch nahi maanga, kis se maanga? Allah se maanga. Lekin agar koi kehta hai: 'Ya Rasool Allah madad' ya 'Al-Madad Ya Abdul Qadir Jilani', toh ye waseela nahi hai, ye direct pukaarna hai! Aur wo kehte hain nahi jee ye bhi waseela hai...
[00:10:35] Mirza: Sahaba-e-Kiram ne qahat ke waqt kabhi qabr-e-Rasool par ja kar nahi maanga. Sahih Bukhari mein 1010 number hadith hai: Hazrat Umar radiyallahu anhu ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari hadith 1010, Inna kunna natawassalu ilayka bi-nabiyyina fa-tasqeena, wa inna natawassalu ilayka bi-'ammi nabiyyina fa-sqina"). Aye Allah, pehle hum Nabi ﷺ ke zariye waseela pakadte the toh tu barish deta tha, ab hum tere Nabi ke chacha ke zariye waseela pakadte hain. Agar faut-shuda zaat ka waseela jaiz hota toh Hazrat Umar Hazrat Abbas ko aage na karte, direct Nabi ﷺ ka waseela pesh karte.
[00:12:20] Mirza: Quran mein Huzoor ﷺ ko Sahaba ke liye dua karne ka hukm diya gaya. Zinda shakhs se dua karwana waseela hai. Faut hone ke baad Sahaba unki qabr par dua karwane nahi jate the. Sahih Bukhari mein Abdullah bin Ateek ki pindli toot gayi toh Huzoor ﷺ ne haath phera jud gayi. Aaj kisi ki haddi toote toh orthopedic surgeon ke paas jaye ga, qabr par ja kar nahi judwaye ga.
[00:13:55] Mirza: Total paanch waseele jaiz hain:
[00:14:00] Mirza: Pehla waseela: kisi nek zinda bande se jo aapke samne maujood ho dua karwana.
[00:14:12] Mirza: Doosra waseela: apne nek a'maal ke zariye Allah ko wasita pesh karna, jaise Bukhari Muslim mein ghaar (cave) wale teen logon ka waqia hai jinhon ne apne nek a'maal ka waseela diya.
[00:14:48] Mirza: Tehsra waseela: Allah Ta'ala ke Asma-e-Husna aur Kalimat ke zariye dua maangna: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-A'raf, Wa lillahil Asma'ul Husna fad'oohu biha").
[00:16:05] Mirza: Chawtha waseela: Nabi alayhis salam ke tabarrukat ke zariye shifa talab karna, jaise Sahih Muslim mein Asma bint Abi Bakr Huzoor ka jubba dhokar bimar ko pilati theen, ya Bukhari mein Umme Salama ke paas mubarak baal the.

### 3. New Claims Inventory (Engineer Muhammad Ali Mirza)

- EM-C01: Invoking absent or deceased figures verbally (Ya Rasool Allah madad, Ya Ali madad) constitutes du'a, and since du'a is worship (ad-du'a huwal ibadah), any such call directed at creation is shirk. (Sources: yt-hqDt_1BwzLc, yt-3-tML7NbATk, yt-0LqCS-zvCxY).

- EM-C02: The hadith of calling unseen beings (Ya Ibad Allah A'inuni) applies strictly to lost travelers in desolated wilderness/jungles (referring to terrestrial angels), and cannot be generalized to calling upon prophets or saints in cities or homes. (Source: yt-3-tML7NbATk).

- EM-C03: Waseela is categorized into exactly five scriptural forms (living person's du'a, righteous deeds, Divine Names, relics/tabarrukat, and praying for the heavenly rank Al-Waseela); invoking persons after death is unlegislated. (Source: yt-sAVly9evIpA).

- EM-C04: Even if Allah had granted authority (ikhtiyar) to prophets or saints, calling on them remains shirk because the righteous figures themselves only ever called upon Allah (Iyyaaka Nasta'een). (Source: yt-0LqCS-zvCxY).

### 4. Counter-Questions Used by Ahl-e-Sunnat (Not in CQ-01–CQ-05)

- CQ-06 (The Semantic Proof from General Vocatives in the Quran):
  Concept: If every act of calling (nida / du'a) is worship (ibadah), why does the Quran use the root d-'-w for the Prophet ﷺ calling the believers (wa rasoolu yad'ookum in 3:153), the believers calling one another (ka-du'ai ba'dikum ba'da in 24:63), and Ibrahim calling dead birds (thumma ud'uhunna in 2:260)?
  Force: Compels the opponent to admit that du'a linguistically means calling/summoning, and that calling becomes worship only when the addressee is called with the belief of divinity (uluhiyyah).

- CQ-07 (The Physical Posture Analogy):
  Concept: Standing (qiyam) and sitting on knees (qa'dah) are acts of worship in Salah, yet standing for parents/teachers or sitting on knees before a teacher (Hadith Jibril) is universally accepted as honor (ta'zeem). Why is a physical posture evaluated by intent and context, but calling (nida) treated as intrinsic worship regardless of belief?
  Force: Exposes the flaw of equating external form with intrinsic worship.

- CQ-08 (Geographic Restriction Inconsistency):
  Concept: If calling upon unseen created beings in the wilderness (Ya Ibad Allah a'inuni) is permitted by hadith, how can calling upon unseen created beings in a city be shirk? Can geographic location transform shirk into tawhid?
  Force: Demonstrates that if an action is intrinsic shirk, it cannot be permissible in any location.

[00:00:00] Razavi: Alhamdulillah Rabbil Alameen was-salatu was-salamu ala sayyidil anbiya-i wal mursaleen, amma ba'd fa-a'oodhu billahi minash-shaytanir rajeem bismillahir rahmanir raheem.
[00:00:12] Razavi: Anbiya alayhimus salatu wat-tasleemat aur auliya Allah rahimahumullah se istimdad aur madad maangne ke hawale se Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke mukhalifeen ki taraf se Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at par shirk aur kufr ka fatwa lagaya jata hai.
[00:00:26] Razavi: Aur kaha jata hai ke jo Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ke ilawa kisi se madad maange wo mushrik hai, wo kafir hai.
[00:00:34] Razavi: Lihaaza ye Ahl-e-Sunnat Barelvi ye mushrik hain kyunke ye Allah ke nabiyon aur waliyon se istimdad yani madad maangne ke qaayal hain.
[00:00:41] Razavi: Jabke bil-hamdillahi Ta'ala humne Quran-o-Sunnat ke dalail ki roshni mein is baat ko wazeh kiya hai aur is par maine mukhtalif bayan-aat bhi record karwaye aur tafseel ke sath is par guftagu ki hai.
[00:00:54] Razavi: Aaj sar-e-dast humne is mas'ala par bilkhusoos ek hadith par guftagu karni hai lekin us se pehle tamheedi taur par ye baatein samajhna zaroori hai ke hamare Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke aqeedah ke mutabiq haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar Allah Rabbul Izzat ki zaat hai.
[00:01:08] Razavi: Allah Rabbul Izzat ki zaat ke ilawa koi bhi haqeeqatan madad nahi kar sakta.
[00:01:14] Razavi: Jo Allah ke ilawa kisi aur ko haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar samjhe wo mushrik hai.
[00:01:20] Razavi: Kyunke Quran-e-Majeed Furqan-e-Hameed ki ye ayat-e-mubaraka Suratul Fatiha ke andar jo hai: 'Iyyaaka Na'budu wa Iyyaaka Nasta'een', is mein hasr-e-haqeeqi hai.
[00:01:32] Razavi: 'Iyyaaka Nasta'een' mein hasr-e-mutlaq nahi hai, hasr-e-haqeeqi hai ke haqeeqat mein ya Allah hum tujh hi se madad chahte hain.
[00:01:40] Razavi: Yahan hasr-e-mutlaq nahi hai balkay hasr-e-haqeeqi hai ke haqeeqat mein mu'een-o-madadgaar hum sirf Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ki zaat ko samajhte hain.
[00:01:50] Razavi: Allah ke ilawa koi haqeeqatan madad karne wala nahi hai.
[00:01:55] Razavi: Haan Allah Rabbul Izzat ke anbiya, auliya ya Allah ki makhlooq koi jinn ho, farishte hon, insaan hon jo bhi hon, wo agar mu'een-o-madadgaar hain, kisi ki madad karte hain qabl az wafat ya ba'd az wafat, zinda hon ya faut-shuda hon, qareeb se hon ya door se hon, jo bhi madad kar sakta hai ya kisi se madad li jati hai toh usko haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar nahi samjha jata balkay usey Allah ki madad ka mazhar, Allah ki aan ka mazhar aur zariya samjha jata hai.
[00:02:26] Razavi: Aur is aqeedah ke sath Allah Rabbul Izzat ki makhlooq se, Allah ke bandon se, farishtoon se, nabiyon se aur Allah Rabbul Izzat ke waliyon se istimdad ki jaye toh wo shirk nahi hai.
[00:02:40] Razavi: Hamare mukhalifeen is mas'ala ki wajah se Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at par shirk ka fatwa lagate hain aur ye nahi jante ke ye sirf Ahl-e-Sunnat Barelviyon par shirk ka fatwa nahi jata balkay bade-bade a'imma-e-muhadditheen, ummat ke auliya aur ummat ke wo akabir aslaaf shuyookh jinki haisiat ummat mein musallama hai un par bhi ye shirk ka fatwa jata hai agar Allah ke ilawa kisi se istimdad ya kisi se madad maangne ko shirk qarar diya jaye.
[00:03:08] Razavi: Ab main insha'Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala is par un a'imma-e-muhadditheen aur ummat ke un akabir a'imma aur muhadditheen ke hawala pesh karoonga jo ummat ke yahan musallama hain, wo bhi Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala jalla shaanuhu ke ilawa Allah ki makhlooq se madad lene ke qaayal hain.
[00:03:26] Razavi: Ek toh baat ye ke 'Iyyaaka Nasta'een' ke andar hasr hasr-e-mutlaq nahi balkay hasr-e-haqeeqi hai.
[00:03:34] Razavi: Agar hasr-e-mutlaq murad liya jaye Allah Ta'ala ke ilawa mutlaqan kisi se bhi kuch maangna, kisi se madad talab karna chahe wo zinda ho ya faut ho gaya ho, wo samne ho ya samne na ho, wo ma fawq al-asbab kisi se madad li jaye ya ma taht al-asbab li jaye, har qism ki madad Allah ke ilawa kisi se maangna wo shirk thehrega.
[00:03:57] Razavi: Aur koi bhi zee-aql jo hai wo yahan hasr-e-mutlaq murad nahi le sakta balkay is ayat mein hasr-e-haqeeqi hai ke haqeeqatan ya Allah sirf hum tujh hi se madad chahte hain, tere ilawa kisi ko haqeeqi mu'een-o-madadgaar nahi samajhte.
[00:04:10] Razavi: Aur doosra ye baat bhi jo hai wo zehan-nasheen rahe ke Allah ke ilawa kisi ko mutlaqan bulana ya pukaarna wo shirk nahi hai.

[00:15:35] Razavi: Phir Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu anhuma ki hadith ka doosra shahid Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Mas'ud radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ki hadith hai jo ke Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir li-Tabarani ke andar 10367 number maujood hai.
[00:16:00] Razavi: Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Mas'ud radiyallahu ta'ala anhu farmate hain ke Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne farmaya: jab tum mein se kisi ki sawari aise veerane mein gum ho jaye fal-yunadi toh usey chahiye ke wo nida de: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir 10367") phrase_as_heard: "ya 'IbadAllah ihbisoo 'alayya".
[00:16:15] Razavi: Aye Allah ke bandon meri sawari ko roko.
[00:16:45] Razavi: Aur iska ek aur shahid Aban bin Salih se Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah ke andar 30438 number maujood hai.
[00:17:10] Razavi: Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani al-rahmah ne An-Nukat Imam Ibn al-Salah ki kitab Muqaddimah ke upar jo Nukat likhi hai us mein safha 161 hai, farmate hain ke agar hadith shuzooz aur nakarat se paak ho aur uske mutabi'at aur shawahid mil jayein toh us se hadith ka sahih aur hasan hona sabit ho jata hai.
[00:18:20] Razavi: Aur phir a'imma-e-muhadditheen ka is par amal kya hai? Imam Tabarani hadith ko bayan karne ke baad kehte hain ke 'qad jurriba dhalik'.
[00:18:35] Razavi: Aur a'imma-e-arba'ah ke andar Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ke bete se ye riwayat hai unke Masa'il: Masa'il Ahmad ibn Hanbal bi-riwayati Abdillah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal.
[00:18:48] Razavi: Is mein mere paas jild number do hai, safha number iska 816 hai.
[00:18:55] Razavi: Aur isi baat ko Imam Bayhaqi ne apni kitab Shu'ab al-Iman ke andar jild number 6 safha number 128 aur safha number 129 par bayan kiya.
[00:19:08] Razavi: Aur wo riwayat ye hai ke Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal rahmatullahi ta'ala farmate hain maine paanch haj kiye hain, do paidal aur teen sawari par. Farmate hain ek haj mein main paidal ja raha tha aur raste mein gum ho gaya, toh maine pukaara: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "ya 'IbadAllah dulluna 'alat-tareeq".
[00:19:42] Razavi: Aye Allah ke bandon raste par meri rahnumai karo. Farmate hain main ye kehta raha hatta ke main raste par aa gaya.
[00:20:00] Razavi: Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal ne ghaib mein Allah ke bandon ko pukaara aur is hadith ke mutabiq amal kiya.
[00:20:20] Razavi: Aur ye shareh Sahih Muslim Imam Nawawi rahmatullahi alayh ki kitab hai Kitabul Adhkar, is mein safha number 225 pe Imam Nawawi ne baab bandha hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "baabu ma yaqoolu idhanfalatat daabbatuhu".
[00:20:42] Razavi: Imam Nawawi ne Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ki hadith ko bayan kiya aur bayan karne ke baad farmate hain ke hamare kibar mashayikh mein se kisi ki sawari gum ho gayi aur wo is hadith ko jante the, unhon ne aise hi kaha toh foran Allah ne sawari ko rok diya.
[00:21:10] Razavi: Aur farmate hain ek dafa main bhi ek jama'at ke sath maujood tha aur unki sawari gum ho gayi aur wo usko pakadne se aajiz aa gaye, toh maine yehi kaha ke aye Allah ke bandon hamari madad karo, toh baghair kisi sabab ke wo sawari thehar gayi aur hamein mil gayi.
[00:21:44] Razavi: Imam Ibn al-Sunni ne Kitab 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah mein is hadith ko bayan kiya.
[00:21:51] Razavi: Aur Ibn Taymiyyah ne Al-Kalim al-Tayyib ke andar jo tayyib aur pakeeza kalmaat hain us kitab ke andar Ibn Taymiyyah ne is hadith ko zikr kiya.
[00:22:15] Razavi: Iske ilawa Imam Jazari ki kitab hai Al-Hisn al-Hasin, Imam Jazari ne safha number 54 pe likha hai ke maine ahadith-e-sahiha se takhrij kiya hai, aur safha number 242 pe yahi hadith zikr ki: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "ya 'IbadAllah a'eenoonee".
[00:23:42] Razavi: Al-Harawi ki kitab Dhamm al-Kalam mein Imam Abdullah bin Mubarak ka mauqif bhi maujood hai.
[00:25:12] Razavi: Yahan tak ke Nawab Siddiq Hasan Khan Bhopali ki kitab hai Nuzul al-Abrar, safha number 657 pe unhon ne zikr kiya aur apna amal likha ke main Mirzapur se Jabalpur ja raha tha aur meri kashti bhanwar mein phans gayi, toh mujhe ye hadith yaad thi aur maine is par amal kiya aur Allah ke karam se main gharq hone se bach gaya.
[00:26:29] Razavi: Achha is maqaam pe Jhelumi ne ek baat ki aur kaha ke ye riwayatein jo hain na wo theek hai kitabon ke andar maujood hain, toh phir aap jo hai na wo sirf isko jangalon tak rakhein, shahron tak na leke aayein!
[00:26:37] Razavi: Ke jangalon mein aise hote hain toh wo jangalon tak rahe na, aap shahron tak toh na rahein!
[00:26:42] Razavi: Ab ek aur condition badh gayi: pehle kaha tha ke ghaib mein pukaarna shirk hai, aur phir ye keh diya ke yani iska khulasa ye nikla ke shehr mein pukaarna shirk hai, jangal mein pukaarna shirk nahi!
[00:26:55] Razavi: Yani apni taraf se wo conditions badhate jate hain.
[00:26:58] Razavi: Halankay shirk shirk hai wo chahe zinda se ho ya faut-shuda se ho, chahe hazir se ho ya ghaib se ho, ma taht al-asbab ho ya ma fawq al-asbab ho.
[00:27:08] Razavi: Jab banda kisi ko apna khuda samajh kar apna ilah samajh kar faqat pukaarega toh wo shirk hai.
[00:27:16] Razavi: Lekin agar banda bande ko banda samajh kar usko Allah ki makhlooq samajh kar usko haqeeqi madadgaar nahi samajhta, haqeeqi madadgaar Allah ko samajhta hai, us bande ko Allah ki madad ka zariya samajhta hai chahe wo ma taht al-asbab ho ya ma fawq al-asbab ho, door se ho ya qareeb se ho, chahe wo nazar na bhi aaye ghaib se bhi ho, toh Allah Rabbul Izzat ke bandon se anbiya auliya se istimdad ye shirk nahi.

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Razavi: Ke Allah Rabbul Izzat jalla shaanuhu ke bandon se istimdad karna aur madad talab karna is bunyad ke sath ke unko Allah ki madad ka, Allah ki shaan ka zariya samjhe, aur haqeeqat mein yehi aqeedah rakhe ke asal mein, haqeeqat mein madad Allah ki taraf se hai.
[00:00:15] Razavi: Aur ye banda jo meri madad kar raha hai jis se main madad ka mutaliba kar raha hoon ye Allah ki us madad ka zariya hai.
[00:00:23] Razavi: Jis tarah zahir mein kisi se apni zaroorat ki cheez mushaqqat museebat ke waqt ya kisi pareshani ke waqt lete hain us se madad talab karte hain toh usko haqeeqi madadgaar nahi samajhte balkay usko Allah hi ki madad ka zariya samajhte hain.
[00:00:41] Razavi: Toh jab ye aqeedah aur nazariya maujood hai ke ye banda Allah ki madad ka zariya hai, haqeeqat mein madad Allah ki taraf se hai, toh chahe wo banda madad karne wala jis se madad li ja rahi hai door se ho ya qareeb se ho, hazir se ho ya ghaib se ho.
[00:01:02] Razavi: Wo Allah ke bande se istighatha aur madad chahe uski zindagi mein ho ya uske faut hone ke baad uski roohani taqat se, uski rooh se istimdad ki jaye, madad talab ki jaye.
[00:01:15] Razavi: Zinda se ho ya murda se, door se ho ya nazdeek se, ma taht al-asbab ho ya ma fawq al-asbab ho, toh is tarah ki madad Allah ke bandon se Allah ki madad ka zariya hai aur haqeeqat mein Allah Rabbul Izzat hi madad karne wala hai.
[00:01:30] Razavi: Ye bilkul shirk nahi aur Kitab-o-Sunnat ke khilaf nahi balkay Quran aur Hadith mein iska saboot maujood hai.
[00:01:45] Razavi: Isi par Shah Abdul Aziz Muhaddith Dehlawi rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh apni kitab Tafsir Fath al-Aziz ki pehli jild safha 10 par Surah Al-Fatiha ki tafsir bayan karte hue likhte hain:
[00:02:10] Razavi: Farmate hain ke jaan lena chahiye ke ghair se is tarah istimdad karna ke us par mukammal aetemad ho aur usko Allah ki madad ka mazhar na samjha jaye, aisi madad ghair se haraam hai.
[00:02:40] Razavi: Aur agar mehaz tawajjuh Allah ki taraf ho aur us bande ko Allah ki madad ka mazhar jaane toh farmate hain ye jo madad hai ye jaiz hai Allah ke bandon se.
[00:03:30] Razavi: Aur Surah An-Naml ki ayat number 40 mein Hazrat Sulayman alayhis salam ka waqia maujood hai ke aapne apne darbarion ko hukm diya ke meri bargah mein takht-e-Bilqis kaun le kar aayega?
[00:03:52] Razavi: Toh Asif bin Barkhiya ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah An-Naml ayat 40") phrase_as_heard: "ana aateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuk".
[00:04:05] Razavi: Main aapki bargah mein takht-e-Bilqis le kar aaonga aapki aankh jhapakhne se pehle.
[00:04:45] Razavi: Ab takht kis tarah le ke aaye? Aankh jhapakhne se pehle. Sawal ye paida hota hai ke kis taqat ke sath le ke aaye?
[00:04:55] Razavi: Ye baghair zahiri asbab ke le ke aaye, Allah Rabbul Izzat ki di hui roohani taqat se le ke aaye.
[00:05:07] Razavi: Toh banda-e-momin jab duniya mein hota hai us waqt bhi Allah usko roohani taqat ata karta hai, aur jis waqt duniya se intiqal farma jata hai uski roohani taqat aur zyada badh jati hai.
[00:05:25] Razavi: Toh Allah ke bande se uski zindagi mein ya uske faut hone ke baad uski rooh ki taqat se banda istimdad aur istighatha karta hai toh bilkul ye Quran-o-Hadith ke khilaf nahi hai.
[00:05:40] Razavi: Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam se marfoo'an aur Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu anhuma se mawqoofan: ye hawala Imam Abu Bakr Ibn Abi Shaybah Al-Musannaf jild 5 safha 423 hadith number 4975:
[00:06:15] Razavi: Farmate hain ke Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Hadith Ibn Abbas") phrase_as_heard: "inna lillahi mala'ikatan fidd-ardi siwal-hafaza".
[00:06:40] Razavi: Farmaya jab kisi ko veerane mein koi ma'amla pesh aa jaye toh pukaare: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "a'eenu 'ibadAllah".
[00:07:05] Razavi: Aye Allah ke bandon meri madad karo.
[00:07:20] Razavi: Aur isi hadith ko Imam Haythami ne Majma al-Zawa'id jild 10 safha 188 pe zikr kiya aur likha hai: 'rawaahu al-Bazzar wa rijaaluhu thiqaat' — isko Bazzar ne zikr kiya aur iske tamaam rijaal thiqah hain.
[00:08:20] Razavi: Aur isi hadith ko Imam Abu Bakr Ibn Abi Shaybah ne hadith 30339 mein darj kiya.
[00:09:45] Razavi: Aur Abdullah ibn Mas'ud radiyallahu ta'ala anhu se Imam Tabarani Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir safha 153 pe hadith 10367 le ke aaye:
[00:10:15] Razavi: Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne farmaya: jab veerane mein kisi ki sawari bhaag jaye toh pukaare: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir 10367") phrase_as_heard: "ya 'IbadAllah ihbisoo 'alayya".
[00:10:45] Razavi: Aye Allah ke bandon meri sawari ko roko.
[00:11:30] Razavi: Aur Utba bin Ghazwan se Imam Tabarani Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir jild 7 safha 48 hadith 13737 le ke aaye:
[00:11:55] Razavi: Farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir 13737") phrase_as_heard: "fal-yaqul ya 'IbadAllah agheesoonee".
[00:12:15] Razavi: Usey chahiye ke kahe: Aye Allah ke bandon meri faryad ko pohncho.
[00:12:30] Razavi: Imam Tabarani likhte hain: 'wa qad jurriba dhalik' — is hadith ke mutabiq amal kiya gaya aur is hadith ko aise hi paya.
[00:13:30] Razavi: Aur ek hawala Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke bete Abdullah se unke Masa'il: Masa'il Ahmad ibn Hanbal jild 2 safha 816 aur 817 riwayat 1090:
[00:14:00] Razavi: Imam Ahmad farmate hain maine paanch haj kiye hain, do paidal aur teen sawari par. Farmate hain ek haj mein paidal ja raha tha toh main rasta gum ho gaya toh maine kehna shuru kar diya: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "ya 'IbadAllah dulluna 'alat-tareeq".
[00:14:30] Razavi: Aye Allah ke bandon mujhe rasta dikhao, meri rahnumai karo. Farmate hain main kehta raha hatta ke raste par aa gaya.
[00:15:00] Razavi: Aur isi hadith ko Imam Nawawi Kitab al-Adhkar safha 225 hadith 628 par darj karte hain.
[00:15:45] Razavi: Farmate hain unke ustad ki sawari gum hui unhon ne yahi pukaara aur ruk gayi, aur Imam Nawawi farmate hain mera apna waqia hai ke jama'at ki sawari bhaag gayi toh maine yahi pukaara aur baghair kisi sabab ke ruk gayi.
[00:16:55] Razavi: Aur Imam Abdullah bin Mubarak ka mauqif Abu Isma'il Al-Harawi ne apni kitab Dhamm al-Kalam mein juz 4 safha 14 par zikr kiya.
[00:17:30] Razavi: Imam Sakhawi ne Al-Ibtihaj mein aur Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne is hadith ko hasan qarar diya.
[00:17:48] Razavi: Imam Jazari Al-Hisn al-Hasin safha 54 pe likhte hain ke maine is kitab ko ahadith-e-sahiha se tayyar kiya hai, aur us mein ye hadith zikr ki.
[00:18:22] Razavi: Aur Ibn Taymiyyah ne apni kitab Al-Kalim al-Tayyib safha 98 riwayat 177 par is riwayat ko zikr kiya aur koi jarah nahi ki.
[00:19:15] Razavi: Lihaaza ye aqeedah Quran-o-Hadith aur a'imma-e-muhadditheen ke amal ke mutabiq barhaq hai.

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Mirza: Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat number 35: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Ma'idah ayat 35") phrase_as_heard: "yaa ayyuhallazeena aamanuttaqullaha wabtaghoo ilayhil waseelata".
[00:00:10] Mirza: Ye subcontinent mein ek aisi ayat hai jis ke upar poore ke poore firqe khade hain.
[00:00:18] Mirza: Aur wo kehte hain Quran mein Allah Ta'ala ne hukm de diya ke waseela talash karna hai.
[00:00:26] Mirza: Waseela purely Arbi ka lafz hai, iska Punjabi waseele ke sath koi lena dena nahi hai.
[00:00:40] Mirza: Yahan Barelvi Deobandi jo dominant firqe hain, inka waseela ye hai ke ye samajhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala tak direct nahi pohncha ja sakta toh buzurgan-e-deen ko beech mein daal diya jaye.
[00:01:45] Mirza: Aur misal dete hain chat ki: chat par aap direct nahi pohnch sakte, seedhi ke zariye pohnchein ge.
[00:02:00] Mirza: Lekin poori zindagi seedhiyon par khade ho kar guzaar dete hain.
[00:03:50] Mirza: Mere bhai, chat par jane ke liye seedhi ki zaroorat hai, lekin Allah tak pohnchne ke liye kisi seedhi ki zaroorat nahi hai!
[00:04:01] Mirza: Kyunke Allah ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Baqarah ayat 186") phrase_as_heard: "wa idha sa'alaka 'ibaadee 'annee fa-innee qareeb".
[00:04:12] Mirza: Jab mere bande mere baare mein poochein toh farma dein main bilkul qareeb hoon, pukaarne wale ki pukaar ko sunta hoon jab wo mujhe pukaare.
[00:07:20] Mirza: Doctor Israr Ahmed sahab farmate the ke insaniyat ka Magna Carta Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat number 186 hai.
[00:07:45] Mirza: Beech mein bande na daalein.
[00:08:10] Mirza: Ambiya role model hote hain, toh waseele ka lafz agar in ma'ano mein bolna hai ke Allah tak pohnchne ka zariya paighambar aur uski kitab hai toh theek hai.
[00:09:10] Mirza: Yahan waseela aur istighatha ko mix kar diya gaya hai.
[00:09:30] Mirza: Hamari zubaan mein waseela hai ke koi shakhs kahe: 'Aye Allah, tujhe tere Nabi ka wasita, mera falan kaam kar de'.
[00:09:43] Mirza: Is mein aapne insaan se kuch nahi maanga, kis se maanga? Allah se maanga.
[00:09:55] Mirza: Lekin agar koi kehta hai: 'Ya Rasool Allah madad' ya 'Al-Madad Ya Abdul Qadir Jilani', toh ye waseela nahi hai, ye direct pukaarna hai!
[00:10:35] Mirza: Sahaba-e-Kiram ne qahat ke waqt kabhi qabr-e-Rasool par ja kar nahi maanga.
[00:10:45] Mirza: Sahih Bukhari mein 1010 number hadith hai: Hazrat Umar ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari hadith 1010") phrase_as_heard: "inna kunna natawassalu ilayka bi-nabiyyina fa-tasqeena".
[00:10:57] Mirza: Aye Allah, pehle hum Nabi ke zariye waseela pakadte the toh tu barish deta tha, ab hum tere Nabi ke chacha ke zariye waseela pakadte hain.
[00:11:08] Mirza: Agar faut-shuda zaat ka waseela jaiz hota toh Hazrat Umar Hazrat Abbas ko aage na karte, direct Nabi alayhis salam ka waseela pesh karte.
[00:12:20] Mirza: Quran mein Huzoor ko Sahaba ke liye dua karne ka hukm diya gaya.
[00:12:34] Mirza: Zinda shakhs se dua karwana waseela hai.
[00:12:54] Mirza: Sahih Bukhari mein ek sahabi ki pindli toot gayi Abdullah bin Ateek ki, Huzoor ne haath phera jud gayi.
[00:13:14] Mirza: Lekin aaj kisi ki haddi toot jaye toh orthopedic surgeon ke paas le kar jayein ge, qabr-e-Rasool par nahi le kar jayein ge.
[00:13:55] Mirza: Total paanch waseele hain:
[00:14:00] Mirza: Pehla waseela hai: kisi nek zinda bande se jo aapke samne maujood ho dua karwana.
[00:14:14] Mirza: Doosra waseela hai: apne nek a'maal ke zariye Allah ko wasita pesh karna, Bukhari Muslim mein ghaar wale teen logon ka waqia.
[00:14:48] Mirza: Tehsra waseela hai: Allah Ta'ala ke Asma-e-Husna aur Kalimat ke zariye: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-A'raf") phrase_as_heard: "wa lillahil asma'ul husna fad'oohu biha".
[00:16:05] Mirza: Chawtha waseela hai: Nabi alayhis salam ke tabarrukat ke zariye shifa talab karna, jaise Sahih Muslim mein Asma bint Abi Bakr Huzoor ka jubba dhokar pilati theen, ya Bukhari mein Umme Salama ke paas baal the.
[00:17:20] Mirza: Paanchwan waseela hai: Jannat ke muqam 'Al-Waseela' ke liye dua karna jo azaan ke baad maangi jati hai.
[00:18:15] Mirza: Baqi chatha waseela: kisi shakhsiyat ki zaat ka waseela pesh karna zindagi tak toh theek hai.
[00:18:25] Mirza: Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein jo nabina sahabi ki hadith hai, wo Huzoor ki zindagi mein unke samne maujood the aur Huzoor ne unke liye dua farmayi.
[00:19:25] Mirza: Faut hone ke baad zaat ka waseela bilkul sabit nahi hai.
[00:20:10] Mirza: Aur jo Tabarani ki riwayat hai Uthman bin Hunayf wali Uthman bin Affan ke daur ki, usme Shabib bin Sa'id par kalam hai.
[00:22:30] Mirza: Surah Bani Isra'il ki ayat number 56-57: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Bani Isra'il ayat 56-57") phrase_as_heard: "qulid'ullazeena za'amtum min doonihi".
[00:23:00] Mirza: Jin hastiyon ke baare mein tumhe guman hai ke wo takleef door kar sakte hain, unko pukaar ke dekh lo, na wo takleef door kar sakte hain na badal sakte hain.
[00:23:40] Mirza: Aage farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Bani Isra'il ayat 57") phrase_as_heard: "ula'ikallazeena yad'oona yabtaghoona ila rabbihimul waseelata".
[00:23:49] Mirza: Jin hastiyon ko ye pukaar rahe hain wo toh khud apne Rabb ke paas waseela talash karte hain.
[00:24:20] Mirza: Toh jinhein ye pukaarte hain wo khud Allah ke muhtaj hain.

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Mirza: Bukhari aur Muslim mein hadith hai: Nabi alayhis salam ne farmaya har nabi ko Allah ne ek mustajab dua di thi jo is duniya mein kar li, maine apni dua chupa ke rakh li hai qayamat ke din ke liye shafa'at ke liye.
[00:00:20] Mirza: Meri shafa'at se har ummati ko faida pohnche ga siwae us shakhs ke jisne Allah ke sath kisi qism ka shirk kiya ho.
[00:00:28] Mirza: Shirk is the most sensitive issue in the sight of Allah. Allah kabhi maaf nahi kare ga.
[00:00:35] Mirza: Aur shirk ki tareef kya hai? Shirk kise kehte hain?
[00:00:40] Mirza: Du'a sirf Allah hi se, aur kisi ke liye nahi.
[00:00:48] Mirza: Ma taht al-asbab mein toh aap jo marzi karein, kisi ko paani pila dein, kisi ka bojh uthwa dein, wo toh theek hai.
[00:00:54] Mirza: Quran mein hukm hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Ma'idah ayat 2") phrase_as_heard: "wa ta'awanu 'alal birri wat-taqwa".
[00:01:02] Mirza: Neki ke kaamon mein ek doosre ki madad karo aur buraiyon mein ek doosre se alag raho.
[00:01:08] Mirza: Lekin jo ghaib mein madad ke liye pukaarna hai, dua kar rahe hain, wo Allah Ta'ala ke sath khaas hai.
[00:01:15] Mirza: Iska climax wo Surah An-Naml ki ayat hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah An-Naml ayat 62") phrase_as_heard: "am-man yujeebul mudtarra idha da'aahu wa yakshifus-soo'a".
[00:01:25] Mirza: Bhala batao kaun hai jo beqarar ki dua ko sunta hai jab wo usey pukaare aur takleef ko door kar deta hai?
[00:01:38] Mirza: A-ilahun ma'allah? Kya Allah ke sath koi aur ilah bhi hai?
[00:01:50] Mirza: Jis se aapne madad maangi ke meri takleef door kare dua ke taur par... Aap Baghdad mein dafan hain aur main yahan se baith kar kahoon 'mujhe paani pila dein', toh shirk hai!
[00:02:15] Mirza: Ye ladai nahi hai ke Maula Ali alayhis salam ko ikhtiyar hai ya nahi.
[00:02:20] Mirza: Maula Ali ko agar Allah ne ikhtiyar diya bhi ho tab bhi Maula Ali ko aap pukaar nahi sakte madad ke liye, kyunke Maula Ali bhi Allah ko pukaarte the!
[00:02:28] Mirza: Aur Maula Ali ka manne wala bhi Maula Ali ka sahih shia kaun hoga? Jo Allah ko pukaare: 'Iyyaaka Na'budu wa Iyyaaka Nasta'een'.
[00:07:00] Mirza: Ek dafa mujhse ek bhai ne kaha: 'nahi, hum toh unko waseela aur tawassul samajhte hain, Allah ko pukaarte hain'.
[00:07:10] Mirza: Maine kaha waseela ka matlab hota hai 'Aye Allah hamari madad kar Ali ke waseele se', aap toh direct alfaaz istemal karte hain: 'Ya Ali Madad' ya 'Al-Madad Ya Ghous'.
[00:07:30] Mirza: Kehne lage Quran mein bhi toh hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Baqarah ayat 45") phrase_as_heard: "wasta'eenu bis-sabri was-salah".
[00:07:38] Mirza: Sabr aur namaz ke zariye madad chaho. Maine kaha iska matlab kya hai? Sabr aur namaz ke zariye Allah se madad chaho, ya koi kehta hai 'Al-Madad Ya Namaz'?
[00:08:20] Mirza: Surah An-Naml ki ayat padhein: jo Allah ke ilawa kisi aur ko dua ke liye pukaarna samajhta hai na, wo usey khuda banaye hue hai, ma'bud banaye hue hai!
[00:08:40] Mirza: Kyunke aage farmaya: 'a-ilahun ma'allah' — kya Allah ke sath koi aur ilah hai? Maine kaha ye wazeh saboot hai ke ye shirk hai.
[00:09:15] Mirza: Maine mehnat karke Mas'ala number 43 aur Research Paper number 3 'Dua Sirf Allah hi Se' likha hai.
[00:09:50] [skipped: off-topic 00:09:50–00:09:58]

### 3. Counter-Questions Used by Ahl-e-Sunnat

- CQ-06 (Semantic scope of du'a in Quran):
  Summary: Asks how the opponent reconciles equating every vocative call with worship when the Quran uses d-'-w for the Prophet ﷺ calling believers (3:153), believers calling each other (24:63), and Ibrahim calling dead birds (2:260).
  Used in: yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M07, yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M09.

- CQ-07 (Physical posture analogy):
  Summary: Asks why physical postures (standing, sitting on knees) are evaluated by intention and relationship (worship in namaz vs respect for parents or teachers), but verbal calling is treated as intrinsic worship regardless of belief.
  Used in: yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M10.

- CQ-08 (Geographic consistency on shirk):
  Summary: Asks how calling unseen beings for assistance can be permitted in a wilderness/desert but classified as shirk in a town or city, asking whether location can alter the theological status of an action.
  Used in: yt-3-tML7NbATk#M13.

- CQ-09 (Non-physical assistance in Quran 27:40):
  Summary: Asks whether Asif ibn Barkhiya bringing the throne of Bilqis before the blink of an eye was accomplished through physical means (ma taht al-asbab) or spiritual power granted by Allah (ma fawq al-asbab).
  Used in: yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M04, yt-vMA-Vcng63I#M03.

[00:00:00] Q: Ye Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki taleemat hain, jis tarah ke Hazrat Ali ke baare mein aata hai ke aapne Hazrat Hasan apne bete ko farmaya tha ke aye mere bete Hasan tujhe jab bhi koi museebat ya pareshani ho toh sirf Allah se mangna hai.
[00:00:10] Q: Hazrat Ali toh keh rahe hain ke aap Allah se maango, apne bete ko wasiyyat kar rahe hain.
[00:00:14] Razavi: Dekhiye ye toh Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki hadith bhi hai na Sunan Abi Dawud mein: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sunan Abi Dawud") phrase_as_heard: "idha sa'alta fas'alillah".
[00:00:20] Razavi: Tu jab bhi sawal kare Allah se sawal kar, wa idha ista'anta fasta'in billah, tu jab bhi madad ke liye pukare toh Allah Rabbul Izzat ko madad ke liye pukar, Allah se istianat kar.
[00:00:30] Razavi: Ab ye hadith maujood hai lekin isi Sunan Abi Dawud ke andar ek doosri hadith bhi hai ke Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki bargah-e-aqdas mein Hazrat Sayyiduna Rabi'ah al-Aslami radiyallahu ta'ala anhu aaye toh Aap alayhis salatu was-salam ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sunan Abi Dawud") phrase_as_heard: "salnee ya Rabi'ah".
[00:00:43] Razavi: Mujhse maango.
[00:00:45] Razavi: 'Idha sa'alta fas'alillah' tu jab bhi maange Allah se maang, aur yahan kya farmaya: 'salnee' tu mujhse maang.
[00:00:50] Razavi: Ab ye dono aapas mein takra rahi hain ahadith? Bazahir takra rahi hain lekin haqeeqat mein takrao nahi hai.
[00:00:58] Razavi: Kyunke ye jo hukm diya ja raha hai ke tu jab bhi maange Allah se maang wo madad haqeeqi hai, haqeeqi madadgaar Allah hai, Allah ko haqeeqat mein madadgaar samajh ke Allah se mangna hai.
[00:01:05] Razavi: Aur jab Huzoor ne apne se maangne ka Rabi'ah ko kaha hai toh Nabi Paak alayhis salam ki madad haqeeqi madad nahi hai, asal mein madad Allah ki hai aur Allah Rabbul Izzat ki ata se Nabi Paak alayhis salam apne Sahabi ko ata farma rahe hain: 'salnee' farmaya mujhse maang.
[00:01:19] Razavi: Ab dekhiye 'Iyyaaka Nasta'een' ya Allah hum tujh hi se madad maangte hain. Sunan An-Nasa'i mein sahih hadith hai: qabeela Hawazin ke log Nabi Paak alayhis salatu was-salam ki bargah-e-aqdas mein aaye toh Huzoor ne unko farmaya ke jab main Zohr ki namaz padh chuka hoon: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sunan An-Nasa'i") phrase_as_heard: "idha sallaytu al-zuhra faqooloo inna nasta'eenu bi-rasoolillah".
[00:01:36] Razavi: Toh tumne Zohr ki namaz ke baad khade ho jana aur khade ho ke kehna ke hum Allah ke Rasool se madad maangte hain, 'inna nasta'eenu bi-rasoolillah'.
[00:01:48] Razavi: Quran Paak mein kya hai: 'Iyyaaka Nasta'een' ya Allah hum tujh hi se madad chahte hain, aur yahan Huzoor farma rahe hain ke tumne kehna hai 'inna nasta'eenu bi-rasoolillah' hum Rasoolullah se madad chahte hain.
[00:01:56] Razavi: Ye dono takra rahe hain? Nahi takra rahe.
[00:01:59] Razavi: Kyunke Allah se madad jab maangein ge toh Allah ko haqeeqi madadgaar samajh ke, Nabi Paak alayhis salatu was-salam se jo madad wo le rahe hain wo Huzoor alayhis salatu was-salam ko haqeeqi madadgaar nahi balkay Allah ki madad ka zariya samajh rahe hain.

Aur jab Huzoor ne apne se maangne ka Rabi'ah ko kaha hai toh Nabi Paak alayhis salam ki madad haqeeqi madad nahi hai, asal mein madad Allah ki hai aur Allah Rabbul Izzat ki ata se Nabi Paak alayhis salam apne Sahabi ko ata farma rahe hain"

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Razavi: Wo kehte hain deewar ke peeche ka ilm nahi, kal ki khabar nahi, deewar ke peeche ka ilm nahi.
[00:00:06] Razavi: Imam farmate hain: Aur ghaib kya tumse nihaan ho bhala, jab na khuda hi chupa tum pe karodon durood.
[00:00:40] Razavi: Huzoor aapse aur ghaib kaun sa posheeda reh sakta hai jab sab ghaib ka ghaib Parwardigar-e-Aalam khud hi nahi chupa aur apna deedar apne Habeeb ko ata farma diya, toh baqi koi ghaib Huzoor ki nigah se posheeda kaise reh sakta hai?
[00:00:56] Razavi: Nabi Paak ne Mi'raj ka zikr kiya aur farmaya: Allah Rabbul Izzat ne apna dast-e-qudrat mere shaano ke darmiyan rakha.
[00:01:08] Razavi: Farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "fa-tajalla lee kullu shay'in".
[00:01:14] Razavi: Har shay mujh par roshan ho gayi, 'alimtu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard', jo kuch aasmano mein jo kuch zameen mein tha main jaan bhi gaya pehchan bhi gaya.
[00:01:30] Razavi: Shaykh Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh Mishkat ki Farsi mein sharh iska tarjuma karte hain: pas daanistam har che dar aasmaan wa har che dar zameen.
[00:02:06] Razavi: Farmate hain iska ma'ana ye hai: Huzoor farmate hain jo kuch aasmano mein jo kuch zameen mein tha sab kuch jaan gaya pehchan gaya aur tamaam juzwi-o-kulli ilm par Allah ne mujhe itla ata farma di.
[00:02:23] [not transcribed: recitation of na'at couplets 02:23–03:44]
[00:03:44] Razavi: Ek taraf un logon ka aqeedah rakhein jo kehte hain nabi ko deewar ke peeche ka bhi ilm nahi na'uzubillahi ta'ala unka aqeedah, aur ek taraf Bareilly ke Tajdar ka aqeedah.
[00:04:00] Razavi: Imam-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat ka aqeedah Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Quran aur Hadith hai, Sahaba ke aqeeday ki tarjumani hai.
[00:04:07] Razavi: Kyunke Sahaba ka aqeedah bhi ye hai ke Huzoor toh apne ghulamon ke dilon ki haalat ko bhi jante hain.
[00:04:15] Razavi: Dil mein ghulam-e-Mustafa ke jo baat aati hai Allah ki ata se mere kareem Aaqa alayhis salatu was-salam apne ghulamon ke dilon ki haalat ko bhi dekhte hain.
[00:04:28] Razavi: Sahih hadith hai Tabarani par, Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal par:
[00:04:36] Razavi: Ek Ansari Sahabi Huzoor ki bargah mein Madina ke hazir hue aur aake arz ki: Ya Rasool Allah kuch sawalat hain jo mere dil mein hain main unka aapse jawab chahta hoon.
[00:04:50] Razavi: Nabi Paak ne farmaya: baith ja.
[00:05:00] Razavi: Abhi wo Sahabi baithe ke ek aur Sahabi Madina ke bahar muzafat se Huzoor ki bargah mein arz-guzar hue, wahi sawal kiya: Huzoor kuch sawalat hain aapse karke jawab lene hain.
[00:05:16] Razavi: Nabi Paak alayhis salam ne farmaya: tera Ansari bhai tujhse sabaq le gaya, pehle uski bari aayegi phir teri bari.
[00:05:30] Razavi: Wo Ansari Sahabi arz karte hain: musafir ka haq pehle hota hai meri bari usey ata farma dein.
[00:05:40] Razavi: Abhi wo sawal karne ke liye sa'il jo Madina ke bahar se dil mein sawal leke aaye the, koi parchi, koi chat, koi khat, koi telephone message kuch bhi nahi kiya, Huzoor ki bargah mein abhi sawal karne ke liye khade hue hi the:
[00:05:55] Razavi: Imam-ul-Ambiya alayhis salam ne farmaya: aane wale, agar tu chahe toh sawal tu na kar, sawal bhi main khud karke jawab bhi main tujhe ata farma doon.
[00:06:20] Razavi: Unhon ne arz ki: Huzoor sawal bhi aap karein aur jawab bhi aap ata farma dein.
[00:06:30] Razavi: Nabi Paak ne sawal kiya phir jawab diya, phir sawal kiya phir jawab diya.
[00:06:40] Razavi: Jab Nabi Paak alayhis salam ne sawal karke jawab mukammal farmaye toh wo Huzoor ki bargah mein arz karte hain: us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko nabi-e-barhaq bana ke bheja, Huzoor jo main dil mein sawal leke aaya tha kuch bhi aapne ghalat nahi kaha, saare sawal durust farmaye hain jawab bhi aapne ata farma diye.
[00:07:05] Razavi: Ye Sahaba ka aqeedah hai aur isi aqeeday ki tarjumani hamare Imam Ahmad Raza Muhaddith Bareilly ne ki hai.
[00:07:20] [not transcribed: recitation of Ala Hazrat kalaam 07:20–08:45]

[00:00:54] Razavi: Farmate hain maine Maghrib ki namaz Sarkar ke peeche ada ki. Maghrib padhne ke baad baith gaya, phir Isha ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya.
[00:01:01] Razavi: Huzoor ne Isha ki namaz padhai, aur Isha ki namaz padhane ke baad apne hujjrah ki taraf, dar-e-daulat ki taraf rawana ho gaye.
[00:01:07] Razavi: Farmate hain jis waqt main Huzoor ke peeche peeche ja raha tha, abhi maine aake bataya nahi ke main kis maqsad ke liye aaya hoon.
[00:01:15] Razavi: Huzoor ki bargah mein arz nahi kiya ke main Huzoor kya lene ke liye aaya hoon.

## Transcript

[00:00:00] [skipped: introductory remarks 00:00:00–00:03:20]
[00:03:20] Mirza: Toh kaha ja raha hai ke aap farma dein mere paas koi khazana nahi hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-An'am ayat 50") phrase_as_heard: "wa la a'lamul ghaib".
[00:03:28] Mirza: Aur na main ghaib jaanta hoon, bilkul wazeh.
[00:03:32] Mirza: Aam Barelvi sahab baqi log iska tarjuma karte hue likh dete hain: na main khud se ghaib jaanta hoon.
[00:03:40] Mirza: Theek hai, ye bhi koi ghalat nahi hai lekin jab aap ye kahein ge ke Allah ke Nabi alayhis salam ko ma kaana wa ma yakoon, jo kuch ho chuka jo kuch hone wala hai iska ilm hai, phir hum aapse poochein ge ke ye aapko kisne bataya?
[00:03:56] Mirza: Quran mein toh hai ke main ghaib nahi jaanta.
[00:04:00] Mirza: Wo kehte hain nahi, Quran mein aaya ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne ghaib par kisi ko muttali nahi karta: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Jinn ayat 26-27") phrase_as_heard: "illa manirtada min rasool".
[00:04:08] Mirza: Magar apne rasoolon mein se. Ye Surah Al-Jinn mein aayega, ya Surah Aal-e-Imran mein 179 ayat mein farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Aal-e-Imran ayat 179") phrase_as_heard: "wa ma kaanallahu li-yutli'akum 'alal ghaib".
[00:04:32] Mirza: Allah ki shaan nahi ke tumhe ghaib par ittila de, balkay apne rasoolon mein se Allah chun leta hai jinke upar ghaib ki khabrein kholta hai.
[00:04:55] Mirza: Toh ye yaqeenan hai lekin Allah ke batane par, lekin jahan par nahi bataya kya wahan nahi?
[00:05:03] Mirza: Quran mein kai jagah hai jab Nabi alayhis salam se pochte hain qayamat ke baare mein, toh farma dein iska ilm toh Allah ke paas hai.
[00:05:50] Mirza: Jab Quran baar baar kahe ke qayamat ka ilm nahi diya gaya aur hum Quran ki baat ko repeat karein toh is mein naapne wali kaunsi baat ho gayi hai?
[00:06:06] Mirza: Jo diya wo hum maante hain, jo nahi diya wo nahi maante.
[00:06:22] Mirza: Allah ne wazeh farma diya: 'wa la a'lamul ghaib' toh farma do ke na main ghaib jaanta hoon.
[00:06:35] Mirza: Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai ke paanch cheezein jo Surah Luqman ke end mein aayi hain wo Allah ke sath khaas hain, unko Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta, wo Allah ke ghaib ki kunjiyaan hain.
[00:06:55] Mirza: Ab un mein bhi aisi cheezein maujood hain ke jo Allah apne paighambaron ko batata hai, maslan usme cheez aayi ke kisi ko nahi pata wo kis zameen mein marega. Lekin Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai Badr se ek din pehle Allah ke Nabi alayhis salam ne zameen par haath rakh ke farmaya: kal yahan Utbah ki laash hogi, yahan Abu Jahl ki laash hogi, yahan Umayyah ki laash hogi. Aur Hazrat Umar kehte hain humne un laashon ko agle din unhi jagahon par paya. Allah ke Nabi ko Allah ne ye cheez bata di thi.
[00:08:30] Mirza: Bukhari mein hadith hai: Umm al-'Ala ek budhi sahabi Uthman bin Maz'oon ki khidmat kiya karti theen, wo faut ho gaye. Allah ke Nabi jab mayyat par aaye toh unhone Nabi alayhis salam ki maujoodgi mein keh diya: aye Uthman, tere liye Allah ke huzoor jannatein hain.
[00:09:00] Mirza: Toh Allah ke Nabi paas khade the, aapne farmaya: tumhe kisne bata diya? Halankay main Allah ka rasool hoon lekin main nahi jaanta ke iske sath, tumhare sath aur khud mere sath kya hoga.
[00:09:40] Mirza: Phir kuch dinon baad Umm al-'Ala ne ek khwab dekha jis mein ek chashma paani ka dikhaya gaya, toh Nabi alayhis salam se zikr kiya toh aapne farmaya ye Uthman ka amal hai, yani waqatan Allah ne usko ata farma diya. Lekin us se pehle Nabi ne farmaya mujhe pata hai na tumhe pata hai.
[00:10:10] Mirza: Aur ye toh Surah Al-Ahqaf mein bhi hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Ahqaf ayat 9") phrase_as_heard: "wa ma adree ma yuf'alu bee wa la bikum".
[00:10:50] Mirza: Bukhari Muslim dono mein hadith hai, Muslim mein badi tafseel ke sath hai: Masrooq tabi'ee kehte hain ke main Hazrat Aisha ke sath tek laga kar baitha hua tha... Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya: teen baaton mein se koi ek baat bhi kahe wo Allah par jhoot baandhne wala hai.
[00:11:35] Mirza: Pehli baat unhone farmayi: jo ye kahe ke Nabi sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne Allah Ta'ala ko dekha hai usne jhoot baandha.
[00:13:39] Mirza: Doosri baat: jo shakhs ye kahe ke Allah ke Nabi ne deen ka kuch hissa bayan kiya aur kuch chupa liya usne bhi Allah par jhoot baandha, Surah Al-Ma'idah ayat 67.
[00:15:10] Mirza: Aur teesri baat Amma Aisha ne farmayi ke jo koi kehta hai na ke Allah ke Nabi alayhis salam ghaib jaan lete the usne Allah par jhoot baandha, kyunke Allah farmata hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah An-Naml ayat 65") phrase_as_heard: "qul la ya'lamu man fis-samawati wal-ardi al-ghaiba illallah".
[00:15:50] Mirza: Sahih Bukhari mein aata hai Bi'r Ma'oonah par 70 qariyon ko dhokay se shaheed kiya gaya, toh unhone marte waqt kaha: hamare Nabi ko hamari khabar kar de ke hum apne Rabb se razi hain aur Rabb humse razi hai. Aur Rasoolullah farmate hain Bukhari ke alfaz hain: mujhe abhi Jibril ne khabar di hai ke tumhare saathiyon ko dhokay se shaheed kar diya gaya.
[00:16:35] Mirza: Ye ek hadith Bukhari aur Muslim dono mein teen aqeedon ki nafi karti hai: number one, aqeeda-e-ilm-ul-ghaib ke Sahaba ka yaqeen tha ke Allah khabar karega toh pata chalega warna nahi. Number two, hazir-o-nazir ke nabi ko hazir-o-nazir nahi maante the. Aur number three, istighatha ke na nabi ko madad ke liye pukara na farishte ko pukara, Allah se kaha ke hamare nabi ko hamare haal ki khabar kar de.
[00:23:40] Mirza: Surah Al-A'raf ayat number 188: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-A'raf ayat 188") phrase_as_heard: "qul la amliku li-nafsee naf'an wa la darran".
[00:23:55] Mirza: Aye Nabi tum farmao main toh apni jaan ke liye bhi na kisi nafe ka maalik hoon na kisi nuqsan ka, illa ma sha'Allah.
[00:24:20] Mirza: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-A'raf ayat 188") phrase_as_heard: "wa law kuntu a'lamul ghaiba la-staksartu min al-khayr".
[00:24:30] Mirza: Aur agar main khud se ghaib jaan leta toh main khair-e-kaseer jama kar leta, wa ma massaniyas-soo' aur mujhe koi takleef na pohnchti.
[00:24:50] Mirza: Agar Allah ke Nabi alayhis salam ghaib jaante hote toh Uhud ke mauqa par aapko ye takleef na aati ke dandaan-e-mubarak shaheed hue aur 70 se zyada Sahaba shaheed hue.
[00:29:40] Mirza: Surah At-Tahrim ayat number 3: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah At-Tahrim ayat 3") phrase_as_heard: "wa iz asarran-nabiyyu ila ba'di azwajihi hadeetha".
[00:29:54] Mirza: Jab Nabi alayhis salam ne apni kisi zowjah se ek raaz ki baat kahi aur unhone baat leak kar di, toh Allah ne unpar zaahir kar diya.
[00:31:35] Mirza: Jab Rasoolullah ne unko khabar di toh unhone poocha: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah At-Tahrim ayat 3") phrase_as_heard: "man anba'aka haadha".
[00:31:50] Mirza: Aapko kisne bataya? Toh Nabi ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] phrase_as_heard: "nabba'aniyal 'aleemul khabeer".
[00:32:05] Mirza: Mujhe khabar di hai Ilm wale ne aur khabar rakhne wale ne. Aapne ye nahi farmaya ke main ghaib jaanta hoon ya ma kaana wa ma yakoon ka ilm mere paas hai, balkay farmaya Allah ne mujhe bataya.
[00:35:40] Mirza: Bukhari aur Muslim dono mein hadith hai: jab main Mi'raj se wapas aaya toh Quraish ne mujhe jhutlana shuru kiya aur mujhse Bayt al-Maqdis ke baare mein sawalat kiye jin ke jawab mujhe maloom nahi the, main itna pareshan hua ke main Quraish ke samne jhoota na pad jaoon.
[00:37:00] Mirza: Muslim shareef ke alfaz hain: Allah ne Bayt al-Maqdis ko utha kar meri nigahon ke samne kar diya, jo wo mujhse poochte the main dekh kar batata tha.
[00:37:10] Mirza: Iska matlab hai ke us waqt aapko nahi pata tha, jab unhone poocha toh us waqt Allah ne samne kiya aur dikha diya.

[00:00:00] Q: Assalamu alaykum jee Mufti sahab, main thoda sa poochna chahta hoon: 'Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wa la rashada' (Surah Al-Jinn ayat number 21), iska zara mafhoom wazeh kar dijiye.
[00:00:15] Razavi: Iska bilkul wazeh hai ke Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam se Allah Rabbul Izzat ne kahlwaya ke aap keh dijiye ke main zaati taur par nafe ka maalik nahi hoon.
[00:00:30] Razavi: Toh ye bilkul wazeh hai ke maine toh ye bar-ha maratib baat kitni baar dohra di hai ke koi nabi, wali, paighambar, rasool zaati taur par kisi tasarruf aur ikhtiyar ke maalik nahi hain.
[00:00:43] Razavi: Mas'ala hai Allah Rabbul Izzat ne unhein jo ikhtiyaraat ata farmaye.
[00:00:48] Razavi: Agar koi banda kahe ke unke paas koi ikhtiyar bhi nahi hai, koi unke paas tasarruf ki taqat hi nahi hai, toh ye phir sareeh Quran-e-Pak ka inkar hai.
[00:00:58] Razavi: Abhi maine aapke samne aayat padhi ke Sulayman alayhis salam ka ikhtiyar hai, Allah farmata hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Saad ayat 36") phrase_as_heard: "fasakh-kharna lahul-reeha tajree bi-amrihi".
[00:01:07] Razavi: Ke humne hawa ko Sulayman alayhis salam ke tabe mein de diya, control mein de diya ke wo Sulayman ke hukm se chalti hai.
[00:01:15] Razavi: Isa alayhis salam farmate hain ke main tumhare liye mitti se surat banata hoon aur us mein phoonk marta hoon toh Allah ke izn se parinda ban jati hai, aur main madarzaad andhon ko korhiyon ko shifa deta hoon.
[00:01:28] Razavi: Ab ye jo tasarruf ki taqat hai Isa alayhis salam ke paas ye kisne di? Allah ne di.
[00:01:34] Razavi: Agar koi banda kahe ke Allah ke diye baghair kisi ko taqat hai toh wo kisi nabi rasool ke paas Allah ke diye baghair nahi hai, Allah ne di hai wo ata maante hain.
[00:01:46] Razavi: Toh jo us ayat mein farmaya gaya wo zaati ikhtiyar ki nafi hai ke zaati taur par main nafe ka maalik nahi hoon.
[00:01:52] Razavi: Lekin jo Allah Rabbul Izzat ne ambiya auliya ko tasarrufaat aur ikhtiyar diye hain, toh wo Allah ki ata se, Allah ke dene se wo ikhtiyar rakhte hain.
[00:02:04] Q: Haan bas ye hai ke main ye poochna chah raha tha, ye toh zahiri zindagi mein dekha jab wo zindagi mein maujood hain, kya wafat ke baad bhi?
[00:02:14] Razavi: Asal mein ye hai na ke jo inkar karne wale hain wo zahiri zindagi mein kab maante hain? Mas'ala toh ye hai ke zahiri zindagi mein wo ambiya auliya ke jo ikhtiyarat aur tasarrufaat hain unka inkar karte hain.
[00:02:27] Razavi: Ab sawal ye hai ke jo zahiri zindagi mein Allah Ta'ala ne unko ata kiye the, jo Allah ne unko zindagi mein diye the, wo kya chheen liye hain?
[00:02:34] Razavi: Unse chheen lene ki koi daleel in logon ke paas maujood hai?
[00:02:40] Razavi: Ke agar zindagi mein maante hain ke zindagi mein the unke paas ye ikhtiyarat, ab sawal ye hai ke duniya se parda kar jane ke baad Allah ne chheen liye hain?
[00:02:49] Razavi: Agar chheen liye hain toh daleel pesh karein!
[00:02:52] Razavi: Agar Allah ne nahi chheene, is par daleel nahi hai, toh phir wo ikhtiyar unke paas unke duniya se parda kar jane ke baad bhi maujood hai.

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Mirza: Point number one: Hazir-o-Nazir ka aqeedah kya hai aur iska baani kaun hai?
[00:00:05] Mirza: Toh bhaiyon Arabi dictionary Al-Qamoos ke mutabiq hazir lafz jo hai Arabi mein hadir yahduru hai, iska matlab hota hai maujood.
[00:00:19] Mirza: Urdu mein bhi ye lafz istemal hota hai hazir, aur iska jo opposite word hai Arabi zubaan mein wo hai ghaib, jo maujood na ho.
[00:00:30] Mirza: Doosra lafz hai nazir. Nazir kehte hain Arabi zubaan mein dekhne wale ko. Urdu mein bhi hum nazar ka lafz istemal karte hain mushahadah karne wala.
[00:00:40] Mirza: Hazir-o-Nazir ka aqeedah Quran aur Sunnah mein kahin bhi is naam se maujood nahi hai, ye khalisatan Soofiya ki istilah hai.
[00:00:50] Mirza: Aur Soofiya ka manna ye hai ke Imam-e-Kainat... jab is duniya mein maujood the us waqt bhi aur is duniya se tashreef le jane ke baad bhi qayamat tak ke liye poori ummat ke halat se waqif hain.
[00:01:17] Mirza: Aur Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ka jism-e-mubarak agarchay Madina shareef ki qabr mein hai lekin roohani taur par Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam poori kainat ke andar maujood hain.
[00:01:30] Mirza: Aur is mein yahan tak inka aqeedah gaya ke Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam is ummat se pehle bhi jitni ummatein guzri hain, Hazrat Adam alayhis salam se le kar Nabi alayhis salam tak, un tamaam ummaton par bhi hazir aur nazir hain, tamaam halat ka mushahadah farmane wale hain apni paida'ish se pehle aur Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki duniya se wafat ke baad.
[00:02:00] Mirza: Aur ye aqeedah sirf Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam tak unhone nahi rakha balkay apne buzurgon aur peeron aur mashayikh ke baare mein bhi aqeedah rakha.
[00:02:13] Mirza: Aur ye itna bada daawa jo hai ke Aap sallallahu alayhi wa sallam apni paida'ish se pehle bhi ummaton par hazir nazir the, ye Mauritania ke andar ek soofi guzre hain aaj se 200 saal pehle Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Sawi al-Maliki, unki Tafsir al-Sawi hai, ye faut hue 1223 Hijri mein.
[00:02:29] Mirza: Surah Al-Qasas ki ayat number 44 ta 46 ki tafsir ke dauran unhone ye mauqif adopt kiya ke Aap alayhis salam agli ummaton par bhi hazir nazir the aur qayamat tak hazir nazir hain.
[00:02:55] Mirza: Is aqeeday ke sub-continent mein sabse bade mawareed:
[00:03:00] Mirza: Ahle Sunnat kehlaane wale teeno giroh India Pakistan ke andar yani Barelvi, Deobandi aur Ahle Hadith ke bhi chand bade ulama is shakhsiyat ko bahut izzat aur ahtiram karte hain aur unka naam hai Shah Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi.
[00:03:30] Mirza: 1052 Hijri, aaj se taqreeban 400 saal pehle ye guzre hain.
[00:04:55] Mirza: Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi ki ek mashhoor kitab hai jo market mein available hai Madarij al-Nubuwwah, Urdu zubaan mein translation ho chuki hai.
[00:05:07] Mirza: Uski jild ek safha 135 aur paanchvein chapter mein jis ka naam hai 'Zikr Fazl-e-Aanhazrat sallallahu alayhi wa sallam', us mein unhone Kitab-o-Sunnat ke dalail ke baghair ye aqeedah ummat ke andar inject kar diya.
[00:05:35] Mirza: Us mein Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi sahab kya likhte hain: baaz aarifeen farmate hain ke namaz mein 'Assalamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu' ka khitab isliye hai ke haqeeqat-e-Muhammadiyyah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam mawjoodat aur mumkinat ke zarre zarre mein maujood hai.
[00:06:00] Mirza: Astaghfirullah. Ye aksar kehte hain Barelviyon ka aqeedah hai ke nabi zarre zarre mein maujood hai. Ye khali Barelviyon ka aqeedah nahi hai, Barelvi, Deobandi ke buzurg Shah Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi al-mutawaffa 1052 Hijri ye unka aqeedah hai.
[00:06:29] Mirza: Likhte hain: isliye namazion ki zaat mein bhi maujood aur hazir hai, lihaaza namazi is ma'ana se aagah rahein aur is shuhood se ghafil na hon taake qurb ke noor aur ma'rifat ke asraar se kamyab ho jayein.
[00:06:44] Mirza: Ye unhone aqeedah diya. Yehi aqeedah phir Deoband ke Rasheed Ahmad Gangohi sahab aur Ahmad Raza Barelvi sahab aur Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Naeemi sahab ne Ja-al-Haq mein naqal kiya.
[00:08:29] Mirza: Pehla hawala Deoband maktab-e-fikr ke sabse bade buzurg Rasheed Ahmad Gangohi al-mutawaffa 1323 Hijri, unki kitab hai Imdad al-Suluk, uske safha number 10 par likhte hain fana fish-sheikh ka aqeedah:
[00:09:00] Mirza: Wo kehte hain mureed ye yaqeen rakhe ke sheikh ki rooh ek jagah mein mahdood nahi hai, mureed door ho ya ke nazdeek, agarchay peer ke jism se door hai lekin roohaniyat se door nahi.
[00:09:12] Mirza: Mureed ko chahiye ke har waqt peer ka tasawwur rakhe aur dili ta'alluq zahir bhi ho, dil mein sheikh ko hazir karke dil mein apne peer se madad mange, Allah ke hukm se rooh-e-peer us par ilqa kar degi.
[00:09:35] Mirza: Is par main wohi ayat padhoonga Surah Az-Zumar ki ayat number 32: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Az-Zumar ayat 32") phrase_as_heard: "fa-man azlamu mimman kazaba 'alallah".
[00:09:40] Mirza: Us se badhkar zalim kaun hai jo Allah par jhooti baatein baandhta hai.
[00:10:20] Mirza: Ab Ahmad Raza Barelvi sahab al-mutawaffa 1340 Hijri, unke malfoozat unke apne bete Mustafa Raza Khan Noori sahab ne jama kiye, Book Corner Jhelum ne chhapa hai, uska page number hai 122 aur hissa hai doosra:
[00:11:40] Mirza: Fana fish-sheikh ke maratib ke baare mein unse poocha gaya ke batayein ye sheikh ka tasawwur kaise kiya jayega?

[00:00:00] Mirza: Hum namaz mein jo padhte hain: 'Assalamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu', iske context mein Bukhari aur Muslim mein Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hai.
[00:00:14] Mirza: Jab tum ye padhte ho zameen-o-aasman mein jahan jahan Allah ka nek banda hai Allah tumhara salam pohnchata hai.

[00:00:30] Mirza: Hum insha'Allah padh rahe hain lekin hamara hazir-o-nazir ka aqeedah nahi hai, Allah ko ja raha hai salam.
[00:01:42] Mirza: Nabi sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki wafat ke baad Sahaba-e-Kiram ab tashahhud mein 'Assalamu alan-nabiyyi' padhte the, ye Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ke baare mein Sahih Bukhari mein hai.
[00:02:10] Mirza: Maine pehle toh anti-vishtaki wala jawab ye diya ke sheikh sahab, iska matlab ye hai ke Nabi alayhis salam apni zindagi mein toh phir hazir the? Agar is se hazir-o-nazir ka aqeedah nikalta hai toh mujhe ye batayein ke Nabi alayhis salam jab Madina shareef mein the Masjid-e-Nabawi mein, toh Makkay wale jo Sahaba hain wo 'Assalamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu' padhte the ya 'Assalamu alan-nabiyyi' padhte the?
[00:02:47] Mirza: Toh kehne lage ke 'Assalamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu' padhte the.
[00:02:54] Mirza: Maine kaha toh mas'ala toh phir wohi hai apni jagah, yani wo phir ye hazir-o-nazir ka aqeedah rakhte the ke Huzoor Madinay mein hote hue bhi Makkay mein maujood hain roohani taur pe? Toh ye toh logically durust nahi.
[00:03:22] Mirza: Ye jhoot hai jo Deoband aur baaz Ahle Hadith ulama ki janib se bola gaya ke ye Shab-e-Mi'raj ki guftagu hai Allah aur uske paighambar ke darmiyan. Ye jhoot hai kisi sahih hadith mein bhi ye baat nahi aayi hai.
[00:03:36] Mirza: Bukhari Muslim mein likha hai ke Quran ki tarah taleem farmaya namaz mein padhne ke liye.
[00:04:15] Mirza: Hum salam arz karte hain namaz mein, aur Bukhari Muslim dono mein hadith hai Ibn Mas'ud kehte hain ke jab hum salam padhte the namaz mein: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Bukhari and Muslim") phrase_as_heard: "as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-saliheen".
[00:04:48] Mirza: Jab tum padhte ho 'as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-saliheen', zameen wa aasman mein har nek bande tak Allah Ta'ala tumhara salam pohncha deta hai, tumhe sath kisi ko by name mention karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.
[00:06:01] Mirza: Toh jab Bukhari Muslim mein aaya ke Allah Ta'ala khud salam pohncha dega toh kisi ko koi tension lene ki zaroorat nahi hai na isme se koi hazir-o-nazir nikaalne ki zaroorat hai.
[00:06:23] Mirza: Nabi alayhis salam ki mubarak zindagi mein bhi aap tak salam pohnchna tha, aaj bhi jab hum durood shareef padhte hain toh Allah se hi arz karte hain na: 'Allahumma salli ala Muhammad', hamara salato salam pohnch raha hai.
[00:07:06] Mirza: Masjid-e-Nabawi mein Huzoor namaz padha rahe hain aur jo baqi masajid mein padh rahe hain wo bhi 'ayyuhan-nabiyyu' padhte the.
[00:09:19] Mirza: Aur qabr-e-Rasool par bhi aap arz karte hain: 'Assalamu alayka ya Rasool Allah', aur 'Assalamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu' mein koi farq nahi hai.
[00:09:26] Mirza: Chaar kitabon ke andar sahih sanad se hai: Muwatta Imam Malik ke andar ke Abdullah bin Umar jab bhi Madina shareef se bahar nikalte ya safar karke wapas aate toh pehle Masjid-e-Nabawi mein do nafl padhte, phir qabr-e-Rasool pe aake arz karte: 'Assalamu alayka ya Rasool Allah', phir Hazrat Abu Bakr ki qabr pe aake: 'Assalamu alayka ya Aba Bakr', aur phir: 'Assalamu alayka ya Umar'.
[00:10:03] Mirza: Toh Abdullah bin Umar Nabi alayhis salam ki qabr-e-mubarak pe 'Assalamu alayka ya Rasool Allah' padhte the aur aap hi ko mukhatib kar rahe hote the.
[00:10:14] Mirza: Aur Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jab Nabi alayhis salam ki wafat hui toh Sayyiduna Abu Bakr Siddiq radiyallahu ta'ala anhu hujrah-e-Aisha mein dakhil hue, Nabi alayhis salam ke mubarak chehre se kafan uthaya aur aapko yahan pe bosa diya aur kaha: Ya Rasool Allah, Allah Ta'ala aap pe do mautein jama nahi karega.
[00:10:49] Mirza: Nabi alayhis salam ki mayyat-e-mubarak ko mukhatib karke Hazrat Abu Bakr ne kya kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Ye Bukhari ke alfaz hain.
[00:10:58] Mirza: Isliye main ye samajhta hoon ke Sahaba-e-Kiram ne isi cheez se ye akhaz kiya tha ke jab bhi hum qabr-e-Rasool par jayein ge toh Nabi alayhis salam ko direct khitab karein: 'Assalamu alayka ya Rasool Allah', 'Assalamu alayka ya Aba Bakr', 'Assalamu alayka ya Umar'.
[00:12:40] [not transcribed: commentary on Surah Al-Hujurat and lowering voices at the Prophet's grave 12:40–18:20]
[00:18:20] [not transcribed: visual discussion regarding the green dome and shadows 18:20–26:28]
[00:26:28] Mirza: Sunan An-Nasa'i mein hadith hai: zameen pe kuch farishte hain jo sayahat karte hain aur meri ummat ka salam mujh tak pohnchate rehte hain.
[00:26:44] Mirza: Tum duniya ke kisi bhi hissay mein mujh pe durood padhoge tumhara durood mujh tak pohnch jayega.
[00:26:48] Mirza: Albatta qabr-e-Rasool ka ek protocol hai, Sunan Abi Dawud mein hadith hai: jo meri qabr pe aake salam arz karega, Allah Ta'ala meri rooh ko lauta dega main uske salam ka jawab bhi doonga.
[00:27:09] Mirza: Ye hadith bilkul sahih hai.
[00:27:38] Mirza: Aapki rooh-e-mubarak Jannat-ul-Firdaus mein hai aur us rooh aur jism ka bhi rishta hai, aur Nabi alayhis salam salam ka jawab dete hain. Na hamara salam pohnchna physical hai aur na Huzoor ka jawab aana physical hai.
[00:28:17] Mirza: Aam qabristan mein bhi aapne dua mangni hai jo Sahih Muslim mein hai: 'Assalamu alaykum dara qawmin mu'mineen'. Aam murdon ko bhi aapne salam kehna hai qabristan jab bhi aapne jana hai.
[00:28:34] Mirza: Wo Allah Ta'ala pohnchata hai. Hamara pohnchna bhi barzakhi hai, unka jawab dena bhi barzakhi hai, aur ye barzakh hai unseen barrier.
[00:32:07] Mirza: Sahaba-e-Kiram ki tarbiyat dekhein, Bukhari Muslim dono mein hadith hai: 70 Sahaba ko jab dhokay se shaheed kiya ja raha tha Bi'r Ma'oonah par, unhone marte waqt ye dua ki: Allah hamare Nabi ko hamare haal ki khabar kar de.
[00:33:01] Mirza: Rasoolullah ne farmaya: mere paas abhi Jibril aaye the aur unhone mujhe khabar di ke tumhare saathiyon ko dhokay se shaheed kar diya gaya.
[00:33:15] Mirza: Ye hadith teen aqa'id clear kar deti hai: number one, Ilm-e-Ghaib ka aqeedah, Sahaba ka ye aqeedah tha ke Nabi alayhis salam duniya mein bhi maujood hon tab bhi Allah jo unko bataye ga wo unke ilm mein aayega, isliye unhone ye nahi kaha 'Ya Rasool Allah unzur halana', balkay Allah se dua ki ke hamare Nabi ko hamare haal ki khabar kar de.
[00:33:35] Mirza: Doosra aqeedah Hazir-o-Nazir: Sahaba ka ye yaqeen nahi tha ke wo wahan baithe hue humein dekh rahe hain, illa ye ke Allah dikha de.
[00:34:34] Mirza: Tehsra aqeedah istianat bhi clear ho gaya, yani madad nahi mangi Huzoor se, Allah se madad mangi.
[00:35:04] [not transcribed: commentary on Punjabi Sufi poetry and polemics 35:04–42:09]

[00:05:03] Razavi: Toh iska matlab ye hua ke difa toh Mirza ne bhi kiya!
[00:05:21] Razavi: Taqreeban ye 11-12 saal purana munazara hai, us mein na main munazir tha na sadr munazir, ek mu'awin ki haisiat se wahan sath baitha tha.
[00:05:43] Razavi: Asal mein tay ye hua tha ke Wahabi munazir ki taraf se ye mutaliba tha ke jo kitab hum aapke buzurgon ke hawale se pesh karein aur us mein koi is tarah ki ibarat pesh karein toh aapne us buzurg ke upar kufr ka fatwa lagana hai.
[00:06:04] Razavi: Toh kufr ke fatwe ke liye humne jawab diya tha ke kufr ka fatwa is tarah nahi lag sakta.
[00:06:11] Razavi: Sahih Bukhari ke andar hadith maujood hai: Nabi Paak alayhis salatu was-salam ne Bani Isra'il ke ek shakhs ka waqia bayan kiya tha ke usne marte waqt apne bachon ko kaha tha ke meri mayyat ko jala dena aur uski khaak hawa mein uda dena, in qadara 'alayya rabbi agar mere Rabb ne mujh par qudrat paayi toh mujhe aisa azaab dega ke kisi ko na diya hoga.
[00:06:37] Razavi: Shariheen-e-hadith ne is par farmaya ke bazahir ye jumla kufriyah hai, lekin us kayil ko kafir nahi kaha gaya kyunke us se ye ghalti shiddat-e-khauf mein saadir hui. Hum jumlay ko defend nahi karein ge, jumla ghalat hai lekin kayil par kufr ka fatwa nahi laga.
[00:07:09] Razavi: Doosri misal Sahih Muslim ke andar maujood hai: Huzoor alayhis salatu was-salam ne tamsil bayan ki ke ek shakhs jiski sahra jangal mein sawari gum ho jati hai phir usko sawari milti hai toh shiddat-e-farah mein khushi ki shiddat mein wo kehta hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Muslim") phrase_as_heard: "Allahumma anta 'abdi wa ana rabbuk".
[00:07:44] Razavi: Aye Allah tu mera banda hai aur main tera Rabb hoon!
[00:07:50] Razavi: Ye jumla bazahir kufr hai lekin hadith mein maujood hai: 'akhta'a min shiddatil-farah' — khushi ki shiddat mein us se ghalti hui. Hum jumlay ki nafi karein ge lekin shakhs par kufr ka fatwa nahi lagega.
[00:08:36] Razavi: Wo jo Chishti Rasool Allah ki ibarat pesh ki gayi thi us par hamare munazir ne jawab diya tha ke tum ye kehte ho ke is waqie ki bunyad par kufr ka fatwa lagao, hum kufr ka fatwa nahi laga sakte kyunke ibarat ke andar likha tha ke Khwaja par kaifiyat taari thi, yani aisi haalat mein unse ye jumla saadir hua jis haalat mein shariat ka kalam nahi chalta.
[00:09:36] Razavi: Aur tehqeeq ke sath maine ye baat sabit ki hai ke ye waqia Khwaja Moinuddin ki taraf jhoota mansoob hai:
[00:09:43] Razavi: Fawai'd al-Salikeen mein is waqie ko Khwaja Bakhtiar Kaki ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya hai.
[00:10:01] Razavi: Hasht Bihisht ke andar is waqie ko Khwaja Yusuf Chishti ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya hai. Ek hi waqia teen alag alag afrad ki taraf mansoob hai, ye daleel hai ke ye waqia sacha nahi hai.
[00:11:11] Razavi: Aur Fatawa Razawiyyah ke andar Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilly farmate hain ke koi shakhs agar lafz-e-rasool bole aur murad ye le ke paigham laane wala hoon tab bhi kafir ho jayega, apne aap ko paighambar kahe tab bhi kafir ho jayega.
[00:11:31] Razavi: Aur Fatawa Razawiyyah ke andar likha hai ke mashayikh-e-Chisht ki kitabon ke andar ilhaqaat hue hain.
[00:12:18] Razavi: Shaykh Abdul Haq Muhaddith Dehlawi 400 saal pehle guzar gaye, wo apni kitab Akhbar al-Akhyar mein likhte hain ke mashayikh-e-Chisht ne koi kitab nahi likhi, ye jo unki taraf kitabein mansoob hain ye mashkook hain.
[00:12:30] Razavi: Kaun Sunni Barelvi musalman hai jo La ilaha illallah ki jagah pe 'La ilaha illallah Chishti Rasool Allah' padhta hai? Koi bhi nahi padhta! Ye ek jhoota waqia hai jo unki taraf mansoob hai.
[00:20:29] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi ne Maulana Tariq Jameel ki kitab Guldasta-e-Ahl-e-Bayt ko promote kiya halankay uske andar za'eef riwayat theen, aur jab sawal hua toh Mirza ne kaha ke kisi kitab ki tareef karne ka matlab ye nahi hota ke 100% sab kuch theek hai. Toh phir hamare buzurgon par ye ilzam kyun?
```

counter_questions:
  - id: CQ-06
    topic: IS
    summary_en: "Asks how the opponent reconciles equating every vocative call with worship when the Quran uses the root d-'-w for the Prophet calling believers (3:153), believers calling each other (24:63), and Ibrahim calling dead birds (2:260)."
    used_in:
      - "yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M07"
      - "yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M09"
      - "yt-f5D6zj2Kr6Y#M07"

  - id: CQ-07
    topic: IS
    summary_en: "Asks why physical postures (standing, sitting on knees) are evaluated by intention and relationship (worship in namaz vs respect for parents or teachers), but verbal calling is treated as intrinsic worship regardless of belief."
    used_in:
      - "yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M12"

  - id: CQ-08
    topic: IS
    summary_en: "Asks how calling unseen beings for assistance can be permitted in a wilderness/desert but classified as shirk in a town or city, asking whether location can alter the theological status of an action."
    used_in:
      - "yt-3-tML7NbATk#M13"

  - id: CQ-09
    topic: IS
    summary_en: "Asks whether Asif ibn Barkhiya bringing the throne of Bilqis before the blink of an eye was accomplished through physical means (ma taht al-asbab) or spiritual power granted by Allah (ma fawq al-asbab)."
    used_in:
      - "yt-hqDt_1BwzLc#M04"
      - "yt-vMA-Vcng63I#M03"
      - "yt-f5D6zj2Kr6Y#M05"

  - id: CQ-10
    topic: IS
    summary_en: "Asks why the Sahih Bukhari Hadith of Intercession uses the exact term istighatha for all mankind going to Adam, then Musa, then Muhammad in distress if calling upon created beings for aid were inherently shirk."
    used_in:
      - "yt-f5D6zj2Kr6Y#M06"

  - id: CQ-11
    topic: IK
    summary_en: "Asks opponents to produce any textual proof from the Quran or Sunnah demonstrating that the spiritual authority, control (tasarruf), and miracles granted to prophets during their earthly lives were revoked or stripped away by Allah after their passing into barzakh."
    used_in:
      - "yt-QiwVYfUcIEk#M04"

  - id: CQ-12
    topic: KR
    summary_en: "Asks how the opponent can argue on one hand that Khalid bin Waleed could never perform an action alleged to be contrary to Shariah to dismiss a sound karamat, while simultaneously accusing other Sahaba (such as Muawiyah and Amr ibn al-Aas) of actions contrary to Shariah in historical conflicts."
    used_in:
      - "yt-jhP_dOsZ2g4#M07"

  - id: CQ-13
    topic: TS
    summary_en: "Asks whether the traveler who in extreme joy mistakenly declared 'Allahumma anta 'abdi wa ana rabbuka' (Sahih Muslim) was declared a kafir by the Prophet, and why classical jurists withhold takfir from words uttered during loss of cognitive control (shiddat-e-farah or sukr)."
    used_in:
      - "yt-knUP0hRf7tk#M04"

  - id: CQ-14
    topic: TS
    summary_en: "Asks how an ecstatic story can be used for takfir when different historical malfuzat attribute the exact same incident to three different people (Moinuddin Chishti, Bakhtiar Kaki, and Yusuf Chishti), demonstrating manuscript unreliability and interpolation (ilhaq)."
    used_in:
      - "yt-knUP0hRf7tk#M05"
