[00:01:00] Razavi: Kisi bhi baat ka kisi shakhsiyat ki taraf mansoob hona shar'an Musalmanon ke yahan musallam nahi samjha jata. Is baat ko dekha jayega ke uski isnad aur uski nisbat sabit bhi hai ke nahi.
[00:01:27] Razavi: Fatawa Razawiyyah jild number 15 safha number 555 aur 556 par Aala Hazrat farmate hain: koi kitab ya risala kisi buzurg ke naam se mansoob hona is se suboot-e-qat'i ko mustalzam nahi.
[00:01:49] Razavi: Aala Hazrat farmate hain ke bahut si tasaneef aisi hain jo a'imma aur auliya ke naam par mansoob hain aur unka suboot unse nahi hai.
[00:02:08] Razavi: Kisi kitab ka sabit hona uske har har juz ka sabit hona nahi hota, kyunke bahut si kitabon mein ilhaqaat hue hain.
[00:02:36] Razavi: Fatawa Razawiyyah jild number 5 safha number 16 pe likhte hain ke jo baat naqal karne wale se sabit nahi aur wo Quran-o-Hadith ke khilaf hai, toh naqal karne wale par radd kar diya jayega aur buzurg ki taraf mansoob hone mein uska suboot nahi maana jayega.
[00:03:49] Razavi: Agar un kitabon mein aisi koi baat aati hai jo Quran-o-Sunnat ke khilaf hai toh wo buzurg ki taraf se sabit nahi hogi.
[00:04:35] Razavi: Iski misal Abdullah ibn Mas'ud radiyallahu anhu ki taraf mansoob ki gayi ke wo Qul A'oodhu bi-Rabbil Falaq aur Qul A'oodhu bi-Rabbin Naas ko Quran nahi samajhte the. Muhadditheen ne farmaya ke ye riwayat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ki taraf jhooti mansoob hai.
[00:05:46] Razavi: Doosri misal waqia-e-Gharaniq hai jo baaz kitabon mein darj hua jisko a'imma-e-muhadditheen ne jhoota aur batil qarar diya.
[00:07:45] Razavi: Kitabon ke andar ilhaqaat hue hain aur ghalat baatein mansoob hui hain.
[00:10:14] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi kehta hai ke aisi kitabon ko chaunk mein rakh ke aag laga do!
[00:11:29] Razavi: Sahih Bukhari mein jo hadith hai ke wahi ke rukne ke zamane mein Huzoor ne pahad se girne ka irada kiya, is hadith ke baare mein Mirza Jhelumi ne kaha tha ke ye gustakhana waqia hai.
[00:11:42] Razavi: Kya Mirza Jhelumi Sahih Bukhari ke baare mein ye keh sakta hai ke isko aag laga di jaye?
[00:11:47] Razavi: Ilmi tareeqa ye hota hai ke jo baat ghalat mansoob ho us par hawashi aur tahqeeqi foot-note likhe jayein, kitabon ko aag lagana jahalat hai.

[00:02:40] Razavi: Allah Rabbul Izzat apne auliya ko karamat ke taur par kashf ata farmata hai aur ilham farmata hai, Allah Rabbul Izzat unke dilon mein baat daal deta hai aur farishte Allah ke bandon se kalam karte hain.

[00:06:40] Razavi: Khatm-e-nabuwwat hui hai, khatm-e-karamat nahi hui, khatm-e-ilham nahi hua!

[00:07:23] Razavi: Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne farmaya: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari hadith 3469") phrase_as_heard: "fa-in yaku fee ummati ahadun fa-innahu Umar".
[00:07:42] Razavi: Agar meri ummat mein koi hai toh wo Umar ibn al-Khattab radiyallahu ta'ala anhu hain.
[00:08:14] Razavi: Sahih Bukhari 3689 ke alfaz hain: agar is ummat mein un mein se koi hai jinke sath farishte kalam karte the toh wo Umar hain.
[00:10:19] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi kehta hai ke hadith ka tarjuma hai ke 'agar hota toh Umar hota', aur kehta hai ke ye 'law' ke ma'ana mein hai ke nabi koi nahi ho sakta lihaaza muhaddath bhi koi nahi.
[00:11:30] Razavi: Jami' Tirmidhi ki hadith 3686 mein alfaz hain: 'law kaana ba'dee nabiyyun la-kaana Umar' — agar mere baad koi nabi hota toh Umar hote. Yahan 'law' imtina' ke liye hai ke pehli cheez nahi hai toh doosri bhi nahi ho sakti.
[00:12:30] Razavi: Lekin is hadith mein 'in' hai: 'in yaku fee ummati'. Yahan 'in' shak ke liye nahi balkay ta'keed aur kamal-e-sifat ke liye hai, jaise Arabi mein kehte hain: in kaana lee sadeequn fa-Khalid (agar mera koi sadiq dost hai toh Khalid hai).
[00:13:36] Razavi: Sahih Bukhari hadith 5683 mein Nabi alayhis salam ne farmaya: 'in kaana fee shay'in min adwiyatikum khayrun' — agar tumhari dawaon mein koi khayr hai toh pachna lagwane mein aur shehad peene mein hai. Yahan shifa ki nafi maqsood nahi balkay afzal-tareen dawa bayan karna maqsood hai.
[00:15:30] Razavi: Mirza ne yahan se U-turn liya aur kaha ke agar Umar hain toh wo Nabi alayhis salam ki zindagi tak the, wafat ke baad nahi.
[00:18:59] Razavi: Sunan Abi Dawud hadith 499 mein Hazrat Umar ne farmaya maine kayi baaton mein apne Rabb ki muwafaqat ki, aur azan ka waqia khwab mein dekha.
[00:26:00] Razavi: Aur Nabi alayhis salam ke wisal ke baad Hazrat Umar radiyallahu anhu ka waqia: minbar par baithe hue pukaara: 'Ya Sariyah al-jabal'.
[00:26:34] Razavi: Madina shareef mein minbar par baith kar Nahawand Iraq mein ladne wale lashkar ko pukaara aur Sariyah ne unki aawaz ko sun liya.
[00:26:49] Razavi: Ye hadith Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal Fada'il al-Sahaba mein, Imam Bayhaqi Dala'il al-Nubuwwah mein le ke aaye, aur Nasiruddin Albani ne Silsilah al-Ahadith al-Sahihah mein hadith 3738 aur 3740 ke tehat sahih qarar diya!
[00:27:14] Razavi: Hafiz Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne Al-Isabah safha 675 par sanad ko hasan qarar diya, Ibn Kathir ne Al-Bidayah wan-Nihayah mein hasan qarar diya.
[00:27:20] Razavi: Aur Ibn Taymiyyah ne Majmu' Fatawa mein Sayyiduna Umar Farooq ko sayyid-ul-muhaddatheen qarar diya.
[00:28:40] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi kehta hai ke ye riwayat ja'li hai aur Muhammad bin Ajlan ne sama nahi kiya. Halankay Dala'il al-Nubuwwah, Lalaka'i aur Fada'il al-Sahaba teeno kitabon mein Muhammad bin Ajlan ne 'haddathana' keh kar sama ki tasreeh kar di hai.
[00:32:45] Razavi: Sahih Muslim hadith 7373 mein Hazrat Isa alayhis salam ke nuzool ke baare mein aaya: 'idh awha Allahu ila Isa' — jab Allah Isa ki taraf wahi farmaye ga.
[00:33:05] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi jawab de ke Isa alayhis salam par qurb-e-qayamat nuzool ke waqt jo wahi hogi kya wo wahi-e-nabuwwat hogi ya ilham hoga? Agar kashf-o-ilham Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ke khilaf hai toh phir wahan kya jawab dega?

## Transcript

[00:00:00] Mirza (played clip): Asma bint Abi Bakr ka qawl toh Sahih Muslim ke andar maujood hai lekin wo ja raha tha Hajjaj bin Yusuf... Asma bint Abi Bakr ne ye zaroor kaha tha kazzab hum dekh chuke aur zalim tu hai... usmein bhi naam nahi hai.
[00:01:06] Mirza (played clip): Mera toh ye hai ke main Mukhtar Saqafi ke baare mein positive nazariya rakhta hoon... Agar usne daawa kiya tha ke ye kazzab tha isne prophethood ka daawa kiya tha toh Sahaba-e-Kiram uske peeche namazein kyun padhte the? Abdullah bin Umar uske peeche namazein padhte the...
[00:02:40] Razavi: Musannaf Abdur Razzaq hadith number 924: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Musannaf Abdur Razzaq hadith 924") phrase_as_heard: "qultu li-Abdillah ibn Umar inna Mukhtara yaz'umu".
[00:02:56] Razavi: Rawi kehte hain maine Abdullah ibn Umar se arz ki: Mukhtar daawa ye karta hai ke us par wahi ki jati hai.
[00:03:11] Razavi: Toh Abdullah ibn Umar ne farmaya: usne sach kaha, kyunke shayaateen apne doston ki taraf wahi karte hain!
[00:03:26] Razavi: Pata chala ke Mukhtar Saqafi par aane wali wahi shaytani wahi thi, aur Abdullah ibn Umar jante the ke Mukhtar wahi ka daawa karne wala hai.
[00:03:49] Razavi: Imam Haythami ne Majma al-Zawa'id hadith 12488 mein Tabarani ke hawale se likha: 'rijaaluhu rijaal al-Sahih' — iske rijal Sahih ke rijal hain.
[00:04:04] Razavi: Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal hadith 5194 mein hai: Abdullah ibn Umar se ek shakhs ne aa kar Mukhtar ke baare mein pucha, toh unhon ne farmaya: agar aise hi hai jaise tum keh rahe ho toh maine Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam se suna hai ke qayamat tak tees kazzab dajjal aayein ge, toh Mukhtar un tees mein se ek hai!
[00:05:40] Razavi: Sahih Muslim hadith 6496 mein Sayyidah Asma bint Abi Bakr ne Hajjaj se farmaya ke Huzoor ne farmaya tha ke Saqeef mein ek kazzab hoga aur ek mubeer hoga. Kazzab ko hum dekh chuke aur mubeer tu hai.
[00:06:18] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi kehta hai ke ismein naam nahi hai.
[00:06:32] Razavi: Imam Bukhari ke ustad Imam Abu Bakr al-Humaydi ne apni Musnad al-Humaydi mein hadith 326 safha 157 par isi riwayat ko zikr kiya aur alfaz hain: 'Amma al-kazzab fa-qad ra'aynahu, ya'ni Mukhtar' — kazzab ko hum dekh chuke yani Mukhtar!
[00:07:09] Razavi: Imam Nawawi Sharh Sahih Muslim mein likhte hain: 'ittaqa al-ulama' ulama ka ijma hai ke is hadith mein kazzab se murad Mukhtar bin Abi Ubayd al-Thaqafi hai.
[00:07:59] Razavi: Imam Ibn Hajar Fath al-Bari mein likhte hain ke Mukhtar Saqafi ne nabuwwat ka daawa kiya. Imam Bayhaqi Dala'il al-Nubuwwah jild 6 safha 425 par likhte hain ke tabi'een ki jama'at ne gawahi di ke wo nabuwwat ka daawa karta tha.
[00:09:07] Razavi: Ibn Sa'd Al-Tabaqat al-Kubra jild 3 safha 109 par aur Imam Dhahabi Siyar A'lam al-Nubala jild 5 safha 233 par sahih sanad ke sath leke aaye:
[00:09:23] Razavi: Sayyiduna Imam Zayn al-Abideen Ali bin al-Husayn Ka'bah ke darwaze par khade hue aur Mukhtar Saqafi par la'nat farmayi: 'la'anallahu Mukhtaran'.
[00:09:46] Razavi: Ek shakhs ne kaha aap us par la'nat kar rahe hain halankay usne aapka badla liya? Toh Imam Zayn al-Abideen ne farmaya: 'innahu kaana kazzaban yakzibu 'alallahi wa 'ala rasoolihi' — wo jhoota tha jo Allah aur uske Rasool par jhoot bolta tha!
[00:10:24] Razavi: Rijal al-Kashshi safha 341 par Shia kitab mein bhi maujood hai ke Imam Zayn al-Abideen ne Mukhtar ke hadaya lene se inkar kar diya aur kaha main jhooton ke tohfay qubool nahi karta.

## Transcript

[00:00:13] Razavi: Pichle dinon Golra Sharif mein Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke aqa'id ke hawale se ek i'lamiya pesh kiya gaya, Mirza Jhelumi ne us i'lamiya par ek video banayi hai.
[00:02:43] Razavi: I'lamiya par usne aitrazaat shuru kiye toh sabse pehle usne aitraaz ye kiya ke i'lamiya ke shuru mein sirf Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem likhi gayi hai durood paak nahi likha gaya.
[00:04:34] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi ne table pe jo kitabein rakhi hain un mein se ek kitab Sahih Bukhari nikaal lein, Sahih Bukhari ko shuru karte hue kya kahin durood paak likha gaya hai? Sahih Bukhari ke aaghaz mein Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem likha gaya hai, durood shareef nahi likha gaya.
[00:05:18] Razavi: Imam Bukhari ki kitab Al-Adab al-Mufrad ke shuru mein bhi durood paak nahi, Khalq Af'al al-Ibad ke shuru mein bhi nahi, Birr al-Walidayn ke shuru mein bhi nahi.
[00:07:15] Razavi: Phir usne ye kaha ke unhone Sahaba aur Ahl-e-Bayt ke naamon ke sath 'alayhis salam' nahi likha, Sahih Bukhari ke mutabiq alayhis salam likhna chahiye.
[00:07:52] Razavi: Mere haath mein Sahih Bukhari ke do nuskhe hain: nuskha-e-Saghani aur kalami nuskha nuskha-e-Kushani, inke andar alayhis salam ka lafz maujood nahi hai, Imam Bukhari ne baqi maqamaat par radiyallahu anhu likha hai.
[00:16:38] Razavi: Phir Mirza Jhelumi ne zaat-o-sifat ke hawale se i'lamiya par aitraaz kiya ke Barelvi zaat ki hadd tak toh ehtiyat karte hain lekin sifat ke hawale se shirk karte hain.
[00:17:14] Razavi: Agar sifat ki bunyad par shirk thehrana hai toh sabse bada mujrim Mirza Jhelumi khud hai, kyunke usne kaha: Allah kehta hai 60 saal ki zindagi mujhe de do main tumhe jannat mein mini-god bana doonga!
[00:18:24] Razavi: Mirza ne kaha: 'Kun fayakoon' ki quality mil jayegi, maut nahi aayegi, chhote chhote khuda hon ge.
[00:18:52] Razavi: Aur phir safai dete hue Mirza kehta hai ke nahi jab khaliq aur makhlooq ka farq aa jaye toh shirk nahi rehta! Jab apni baari aati hai toh ye kehta hai, hamari baari mein kehta hai shirk ho gaya.
[00:19:05] Razavi: Hum kehte hain Quran-o-Sunnat ki roshni mein jab zaati aur ata'i ka farq aa jaye, haqeeqi aur majazi ka farq aa jaye toh shirk nahi rehta.
[00:19:30] Razavi: Quran mein Allah Samee'-o-Baseer hai, lekin Surah Al-Insan mein bande ko bhi samee'-o-baseer banaya. Allah Ra'oof-o-Raheem hai, Surah At-Tawbah mein Nabi alayhis salam ko bhi ra'oof-o-raheem farmaya. Farq kya hai? Zaati aur ata'i ka farq hai.
[00:22:03] Razavi: Phir i'lamiya mein likha tha: Allah Ta'ala har shay ka khaliq hai lekin shar ki nisbat uski taraf nahi karni chahiye.
[00:22:19] Razavi: Mirza Jhelumi ne is par aitraaz kiya ke ye kya deen ki khidmat ho rahi hai ke tamaam af'aal ka khaliq Allah hai lekin buray af'aal ki nisbat Allah ki taraf karna jaiz nahi hai!
[00:24:28] Razavi: Halankay Sahih Muslim ki hadith number 1812 mein Nabi Paak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki du'a-e-istiftah maujood hai: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Muslim hadith 1812") phrase_as_heard: "wal-khayru kulluhu fee yadayka wash-sharru laysa ilayk".
[00:24:58] Razavi: Kul ki kul khayr tere haathon mein hai aur shar ki nisbat teri taraf nahi hai!
[00:25:04] Razavi: Mu'tazilah kehte hain banda apne af'aal ka khud khaliq hai. Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka aqeedah ye hai ke insaan ke a'maal ka khaliq Allah hai, aur insaan apne a'maal ka kaasib hai.
[00:25:41] Razavi: Surah As-Saffat ayat 96: [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah As-Saffat ayat 96") phrase_as_heard: "wallahu khalaqakum wa ma ta'maloon".
[00:25:51] Razavi: Allah ne tumhe bhi paida kiya aur jo tum karte ho usko bhi paida kiya. Khaliq Allah hai, lekin adaban shar ki nisbat Allah ki taraf nahi karni chahiye.
[00:27:25] Razavi: Imam Bayhaqi Kitab al-I'tiqad safha 147 pe likhte hain: tamaam af'aal khayr hon ya shar hon wo Allah ki takhleeq se saadir hote hain.
[00:28:44] Razavi: Aur safha 151 par Sahih Muslim ki hadith 1812 ke tehat likhte hain ke is hadith mein adab sikhaya gaya hai ke Allah ki sana bayan karte hue behtar umoor ki nisbat ki jaye, shar ki nisbat na ki jaye.
[00:29:24] Razavi: Imam Nawawi Sharh Sahih Muslim mein Imam Khattabi ka qawl naqal karte hain ke adaban ye na kaha jaye: 'Ya Khaliqa al-khanazeer' (aye khanzeeron ke paida karne wale) ya 'Ya Rabba ash-sharr', balkay achay umoor ki nisbat ki jaye.
[00:31:16] Razavi: Imam Bukhari ki mustaqil kitab hai Khalq Af'al al-Ibad safha 24 par baab qaim kiya hai 'Bab Af'al al-Ibad', hadith zikr ki: Allah har saani' aur uski san'at ka khaliq hai. Khaliq Allah hai aur banda kaasib hai.

[00:11:35] A: Ye jo riwayat hai al-Mu'jam al-Awsat ke andar Imam Haythami ne isko bayan kiya aur Imam Haythami is riwayat ko zikr karne ke baad Majma' al-Zawa'id ki jild number 7 safha number 643 pe 12488 number riwayat zikr karne ke baad likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Majma' al-Zawa'id 7/643", phrase_as_heard: "rawahu al-Tabarani fil-Awsat wa rijaluhu rijalus-sahih") isko Imam Tabarani ne apni kitab Awsat mein zikr kiya hai aur iske rijal Sahih ke rijal hain aur ye mere paas al-Mu'jam al-Awsat ka jo Jordan se chhapa hua nuskha hai uske muhaqqiq ne neeche likha hai isnaduhu sahih ke iski sanad sahih hai lihaza Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma se sahih sanad se ye sabit hai ke woh to Mukhtar Thaqafi ke baare mein ye nazriyah rakh rahe hain ke Mukhtar Thaqafi jo wahi ka da'wa kar raha hai ye jhoota aur kazzab hai.

[00:12:56] A: Reh gaye ke woh Mukhtar Thaqafi ke maanne walon ke peeche namazein parhte the to ye bilkul riwayat sabit nahin munqati' hai Yunus bin Ubayd ka Nafi se riwayat sunna sabit nahin hai aur a'imma-e-Ahl-e-Bayt mein se Sayyiduna Imam Zayn al-Abidin Sayyid us-Sajideen radiyallahu ta'ala anhu se sahih sanad ke sath Imam Muhammad bin Sa'd al-Mutawaffa 230 Hijri al-Tabaqat al-Kubra ki jild number 5 safha number 109 pe leke aaye ke [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Tabaqat al-Kubra 5/109", phrase_as_heard: "anna Aliya bnal-Husayn qama fa-la'ana al-Mukhtar") Imam Zayn al-Abidin Ka'batullah ke darwaze par khare hue aur khare hoke Mukhtar Thaqafi par aapne la'nat farmayi to ek shakhs ne kaha ke aap Mukhtar Thaqafi par la'nat farma rahe hain jabke woh aapki wajah se zabah kiya gaya to Sayyiduna Imam Zayn al-Abidin ne farmaya [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Tabaqat al-Kubra", phrase_as_heard: "innahu kazzab yakdhibu alallahi wa ala Rasoolih") Mukhtar Thaqafi kazzab hai woh Allah aur uske Rasool par jhoot bandhta hai ye Imam Zayn al-Abidin ka mauqif hai.

[00:14:16] A: Abdullah bin Umar ka mauqif aa gaya tabi'een ki jama'at ka mauqif hai Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal ke andar woh riwayaat maujood hain muhadditheen ne Mukhtar Thaqafi ko kazzab likha aur kaha ke woh nabuwwat ka mudda'i tha ye ek kitab al-Thiqat hai Imam Ibn Hibban ki jab Mukhtar Thaqafi ka yahan unhone zikr kiya Safiyyah bint Abi Ubayd ka tazkirah karte likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Thiqat li-Ibn Hibban", phrase_as_heard: "wa-hiya ukhtu al-Mukhtar ibn Abi Ubayd al-mutanabbi bil-Iraq") Mukhtar Thaqafi woh hai jis ne Iraq pe nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya to muhadditheen ne is baat ko likha ke Mukhtar Thaqafi nabuwwat ka mudda'i tha Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ka munkir tha Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ka daku tha.

[00:15:00] A: Is Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ke munkir aur Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ke daku ko Mirza Jhelumi uska difa kar raha hai aur uske liye narm gosha paida kar raha hai aur da'way kya hain? Da'way ye kar raha hai ke main Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ka sachha sipahi hoon to ab Mirza Jhelumi ka pole khul gaya ek taraf jab kashf-o-ilham ki baat aaye to kehta hai jo kashf-o-ilham ko maante hain woh bhi Khatam-e-Nabuwwat ke daku hain aur ek taraf jo sarahatan apne liye wahi ka iqrar kar raha hai aur kehta hai mere paas Jibreel aate hain aur jis ke nabuwwat ka da'wa karne par ulama ittifaq kar rahe hain ke usne nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya ye kazzab tha uske baare mein kehta hai ke nahin jee uske baare mein jo kaha jaata hai ke nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya ye sabit nahin hai to is tareeqe se uske liye narm gosha logon ke dilon mein Mirza Jhelumi paida karne ki koshish kar raha hai.

### New Counter-Question Themes Registered

- CQ-22 (Contradiction on Theological Distinctions / "Mini God" vs Zati-Ata'i): If distinctions such as Zati vs Ata'i (inherent vs bestowed), Haqiqi vs Majazi (actual vs figurative), and Qadeem vs Hadith (eternal vs contingent) are condemned as un-Islamic post-Sahaba fabrications when Ahl al-Sunnah use them to explain prophetic miracles and intercession, why does the opponent rely on those exact same distinctions (Khaliq vs Makhluq, Zati vs Ata'i, Hadith vs Qadeem) to defend his own controversial claim that believers will be made "mini gods" in Paradise? Furthermore, how can these distinctions be rejected when the Quran itself attributes taking souls both to Allah literally (Surah Az-Zumar 39:42) and to the Angel of Death figuratively (Surah As-Sajdah 32:11), and attributes giving children both to Allah (Surah Ash-Shura 42:49) and to Gabriel in the first person (Surah Maryam 19:19)?

[00:26:56] A: Sahih Bukhari ki 3864 number ek riwayat parh ke us ghali Rafzi ne jo ke America ke andar baitha hai aur baaz deegar rawafiz ne is par aitraaz kiya aur Mirza kehta hai jee woh sahih to kehte hain woh mujhe kuch hissa maanna parega ab ye riwayat hai jis ki bunyad Mirza ne kaha ke mujhe kuch hissa maanna parega ke jis mein riwayat ke andar lafz maujood hai Hazrat Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhu jab Makkah al-Mukarramah ke andar maujood the to apne ghar ke andar aap baithe hue the [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari 3864", phrase_as_heard: "kha'ifan") lafz hai ke kha'ifan yani dare hue khauf ki halat mein apne ghar ke andar baithe hue the ab is se ye nateeja rawafiz ne nikalne ki koshish ki hai ke Hazrat Umar to dare hue the halanke Hazrat Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ki shuja'at bahaduri aur aapka jo ru'b o dabdaba usko maine aapke samne riwayat aur ahadees se pesh kar diya.

[00:11:06] A: Us par daleel hamare paas dalail is par maujood hain aur ek hadees main aapke samne parhta hoon Sunan Abi Dawud se 1212 number hadees hai Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma farmate hain balki Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma ek maqaam pe kheton mein aap tashreef-farma the ke ek qasid aaya aur usne aake bataya ke aapki zaujah mohtarmah woh bohot aleel hain aur faut hone ke qareeb hain wapas jaldi aap ghar pohanchein to aapne fauran sawari li aur baithe aur apne ghar ki taraf chal diye aur chalte chalte saathi jo sath tha usne kaha as-salatu as-salah Huzoor namaz namaz aapne farmaya sir sir chalta ja chalta ja chalte chalte ek maqaam woh aaya ke aap utray aapne Maghrib ki namaz ada ki phir thora sa intezar kiya hatta ke shafaq ghayab ho gayi yani Maghrib ka waqt khatam hoke Isha ka shuru ho gaya aapne Isha ki namaz parhi aur farmaya ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallama ko jab kisi kaam ki jaldi hua karti thi Huzoor bhi aise hi kiya karte the.

[00:12:16] A: Is hadees se kya sabit hua do namazon ko Huzoor jama kiya karte the lekin kis tarah Jam' Soori kiya karte the ke namaz ko uske aakhir waqt mein parh liya safar mein ya kisi majboori ya kisi jaldi ke mauqe par aur agli namaz ka jyun hi waqt hua agli namaz ko parh liya aur do namazein sooratan to jama hui hain lekin haqeeqatan do namazein jama nahin huin to Imam-e-Azam farmate hain ke safar ki halat mein soori jama karna ye to durust hai lekin haqeeqatan do namazein jama karna ye ja'iz nahin hai kyunke namaz waqt-e-muqarrarah par farz hai.

[00:13:17] A: Suniye zara agar do namazon ko jama karna haqeeqatan ja'iz hota baghair kisi uzr ke baghair kisi barish ke baghair kisi khauf ke baghair uzr ke bhi ja'iz hota to jiska uzr hai uske liye to ba-darjah-e-awla ja'iz hona chahiye tha samajhiye zara baat ko jiske liye uzr nahin hai uske liye bhi ja'iz to jiske liye uzr hai uske liye ba-darjah-e-awla ja'iz hona chahiye lekin hum sahih hadees dekhte hain jo ke Jami at-Tirmidhi ke andar hadees maujood hai sahih hadees hai Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki bargah-e-aqdas mein Hazrat Hamnah bint Jahsh radiyallahu ta'ala anha sahabiyah hazir huin aur arz ki ya Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam mujhe auraton wale jo mamlaat jis tarah auraton ko bleeding hoti hai woh itni shadeed itni zyada hoti hai ke isne mujhe namaz aur rozay se bhi rok diya hai main itni zyada majboor hoon aur ma'zoor hoon to Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne unhein hukum diya hatta ke unhone jab ye uzr apne pesh kiye ma'zoorah theen to Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ne farmaya ke tum ye kiya karo ke tum Zuhr ki namaz ko mu'akhkhar kiya karo kya kiya karo mu'akhkhar kiya karo farmaya [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Jami at-Tirmidhi", phrase_as_heard: "akhkhiridh-Zuhra wa 'ajjilil-Asra") Zuhr ki namaz ko mu'akhkhar karo aur Asr ki namaz ko mu'ajjal karo yani Zuhr ko uske aakhiri waqt mein aur Asr ko uske pehle waqt mein karke is tarah tum do namazein ikatthi karke parh liya karo kin ko bataya ma'zoorah ko aur kaun sa tareeqa bataya Jam' Soori wala agar Jam' Haqiqi do namazon ko ek waqt mein parhna baghair uzr ke bhi ja'iz hota to ye to ma'zoorah theen inka to uzr tha inke liye to ba-darjah-e-awla ja'iz hona chahiye tha lekin Huzoor ne ye Jam' Soori wala tareeqa ma'zoorah ko bata ke ye bata diya ke sooratan to do namazein jama ho sakti hain haqeeqatan do namazon ko jama karna ja'iz nahin hai.

[00:15:53] A: Ab woh jo hadees bhai ne bayan ki hai kehte hain Bukhari mein hai Bukhari ke andar hadees Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu ta'ala anhu wali maujood hai lekin usmein ye poori tafseel maujood nahin hai haan albatta ye ke Imam Muslim iske muta'addid turuq is riwayat ke leke aaye hain is riwayat par maine tafseeli kalam kiya aur Abu az-Zubayr ke upar kafi muhadditheen ka kalam hai iske jo rawi hain Abu az-Zubayr Abu az-Zubayr par bhi kalam hai aur is par Imam Tirmidhi ne Jami at-Tirmidhi ke aakhir mein jo apni Kitab al-Ilal likhi hai Kitab al-Ilal ke andar farmate hain ke meri kitab Jami at-Tirmidhi ke andar jitni ahadees hain woh saari ahadees aisi hain jin par ummat ke kisi na kisi ahl-e-ilm tabqay ne amal kiya hai [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Kitab al-Ilal by Imam at-Tirmidhi", phrase_as_heard: "ma khala hadeethayn") farmate hain siwaye do hadeeson ke un mein se ek hadees ye hai jo bhai ne parh ke sunayi hai kyun isliye ke is hadees ka jo matn aur sanad hai us par bohot saare ishkalaat aur bohot saare iradaat hain jis ki bunyad pe ahl-e-ilm muhadditheen aur ulama aur fuqaha ne is hadees par amal nahin kiya.

[00:16:55] A: Aur agar is hadees ko aap tafseel ke sath leinge to jahan ye zikr hai na ke baghair barish aur baghair kisi khauf ke do namazon ko Nabi alayhis salatu was salam ne Madinah Tayyibah mein jama kiya hai isi hadees ko jab hum Sunan an-Nasa'i se nikal ke 506 ya 507 number dekh lein usmein ye hadees maujood hai ke usmein riwayat ke matn ke andar maujood hai khud Abdullah ibn Abbas farmate hain ke Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ne jo do namazein jama ki hain woh kis tarah ki hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sunan an-Nasa'i 506", phrase_as_heard: "akhkhara al-Zuhra wa 'ajjala al-Asra") Huzoor ne Zuhr ko mu'akhkhar kiya tha Asr ko mu'ajjal yani uske pehle waqt mein parha tha to Huzoor ne woh jo do namazein jama ki theen woh do namazein bhi soori theen haqiqi jama nahin theen.

[00:17:50] A: Aur sahih Muslim ke andar jo aayi hai usmein bhi jo hadees ke rawi hain Abu ash-Sha'tha Jabir bin Zayd jo hadees bayan kar rahe hain rawi-e-hadees adra bi-marwiyyihi hadees ka rawi apni riwayat ko zyada jaanta hai sahib al-bayt adra bima feehi ghar wala zyada jaanta hai ke uske ghar mein kya hai hadees ka rawi zyada behtar jaanta hai ke is hadees ka matlab kya hai Jabir bin Zayd Abu ash-Sha'tha Sahih Muslim ke woh rawi woh kehte hain ye jo hadees hai na ke Huzoor ne do namazein jama ki hain farmate hain akhkhara al-Zuhra wa 'ajjala al-Asra woh aise ki hai ke Zuhr ko mu'akhkhar kiya aur Asr ko mu'ajjal kiya hai Jam' Soori thi Jam' Haqiqi nahin thi aur matn ke andar maujood hai Sunan an-Nasa'i ke andar ke woh Jam' Soori thi Jam' Haqiqi nahin thi.

[00:19:55] D: Muneeb Altaf bhai Muslim Town se aaye hain unhone sawal kiya hai ke abhi aapne farmaya ke imam ke peeche qira'at nahin karni to tashahhud mein Attahiyyat imam ke peeche parhte hain iska jawab irshad farmayein?

[00:20:03] A: Iska jawab ye hai ke tashahhud mein Attahiyyat qira'at nahin hai na qira'at ka itlaq Quran-e-Pak ki tilawat pe hota hai na jab hum qira'at ka lafz bolte hain to us pe itlaq hota hai Quran-e-Majeed ki tilawat pe Quran-e-Majeed ki tilawat sirf qiyam ki halat mein hai hatta ke ahadees-e-sahiha ke andar maujood hai ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam ne ruku mein Quran ki tilawat karne se mana farmaya hai ruku mein Quran ki tilawat nahin kar sakte sirf qiyam ki halat mein Quran ki tilawat kareinge Attahiyyat woh duayein hain azkar hain woh Quran ki tilawat nahin hai lihaza baqi azkar aur baqi duayein tasbeehat woh parhi jayeingi sirf Quran ki tilawat imam ke peeche nahin karni woh to hadees mein aa gaya jab imam takbeer kahe tum bhi takbeer kaho aur jab Quran parhe to tum chup raho.

[00:20:56] D: Adeel Attari: Hum tashahhud mein baithte hain to Ashhadu alla ilaha illallah parh ke hum ungli ko uthate hain illallah pe gira dete hain aur jo doosre maslak ke hain woh usko gardish mein rakhte hain harkat dete hain to is par bhi hamare paas mukhtalif riwayat aur aasaar maujood hain?

[00:21:20] A: Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki jo sunnat hai namaz mein woh hai tashahhud ki halat mein ye sabbabah ungli iske sath ishara karna kya hai ishara karna hadees mein aata hai ke Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam is ungli ke sath sabbabah ke sath ishara karte the Huzoor iske sath dua karte the ab jab Huzoor ishara karte the sawal ye paida hota hai ke Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ungli se ishara kab karte the to is par ulama ne tafseel ke sath likha Imam Ibn Abidin Shami alayhir rahmah ne unke jo rasa'il chhape hain Rasa'il Ibn Abidin usmein aapka mustaqil mukammal is par ek risalah aur tehqeeqi maqalah maujood hai aapne tafseel ke sath likha ke ye jo ishara hai ye Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ne kis mauqe par kiya acha jin ahadees aur riwayat ke andar yuharriku biha ke kalimaat hain woh bilkul shaadh riwayat hai as-Sunan al-Kubra Imam Bayhaqi ki kitab ke andar ek riwayat hai ke kuffar ye kehte the ke Muhammad ungli ke is isharay se na'udhubillahi ta'ala jadu karte hain to jawab diya gaya ke Allah ke Nabi jadu nahin karte balki Allah ke Nabi Rab ki tawheed ka ailan karte hain ungli ke isharay se kya karte hain tawheed ka ailan Allah Rabbul Aalameen ki wahdaniyat ka jo ishara aur uske sath ailan karte hain Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ab ye hai ke tashahhud mein Allah ki wahdaniyat ka ailan kis kalimah pe hota hai Ashhadu alla ilaha illallah to lihaza hamare a'immah ne isi hadees aur riwayat ki bunyad pe ye kaha ke jab namaz parhi jaye ungli se ishara kiya jaye dua ki jaye to la ilaha illallah kehte hue la par ungli uthayein aur illallah par mukammal ho jaati hai lihaza is par ishara aur dua karke ungli ko normal usi tareeqe se sunnat ke mutabiq hath ko rakh liya jaye taake in hadeeson par amal ho jaye.

[00:23:50] D: Osama bhai Birmingham se sawal kar rahe hain woh keh rahe hain ke social media ke zariye ek aitraaz samne aaya hai ke Tafsir Na'eemi mein Surah Kahf ke tehat Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Na'eemi sahab ne likha hai ke Durood-e-Ibrahimi namaz ke alawa parhna gunah hai to is hawale se zara kuch tafseel?

[00:24:16] A: Iska maine jawab diya hua hai social media pe Mirza Jhelumi ne is baat ko uchhala aur yahan tak jhoot bola waise to kehte hain ke hum bari tehqeeq karte hain research karte hain aur kaha jee ke Tafsir Na'eemi mein Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Na'eemi sahab ne likha hai halanke ye baat Mirza Jhelumi ki bilkul batil hai aur jhooti aur ghalat hai Tafsir Na'eemi ka ye wala portion aur ye wala hissa jis maqaam pe ye baat likhi hai woh hissa Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Na'eemi sahab ka nahin hai balki baad mein unke betay ne woh baat likhi hai Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Na'eemi sahab ne ye baat nahin likhi aur doosri baat ye hai ke ye baat sahih bhi nahin hai hum is baat ko own nahin karte na is baat ko qabool karte hain balki hamare Imam Ahl-e-Sunnat ke tarjuman Aala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Muhaddith Barelvi rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne Fatawa Razawiyyah ki chhati jild ke andar likha hai ke sab duroodon se afzal durood Durood-e-Ibrahimi hai kaun sa durood hai Durood-e-Ibrahimi hai lihaza hamare Imam ka jo fatwa aur bayan hai woh bilkul wazeh hai ke sab duroodon se afzal Durood-e-Ibrahimi hai ye baat jo bayan ki gayi ghalat hai hum isko own nahin karte isko qabool nahin karte.

[00:25:30] D: Ahmad Raza Siddiqui: Tamam namaz ka section karne ke baad bhi baaz ahbaab ye kaheinge ke namaz hi parhni hai to jis marzi ke peeche parh lein namaz Allah ki parhni hai is hawale se guzarish?

[00:25:50] A: Namaz parhni hai to na'udhubillah iska matlab ye to nahin kisi Yahudi ya Isayi ke peeche kharay hoke namaz parheinge ya kisi Qadiani ke peeche kharay hoke namaz parheinge unhi se pooch lein ke aap parh leinge kisi Qadiani ke peeche namaz? Kaheinge nahin jee unke to aqaid batil hain unke to aqaid kufriyah hain to hum kehte hain ke woh Qadiani ho ya koi aur ho jinke aqaid kufriyah gustakhana aur bay-adabi wale aqaid hain unke peeche kisi Sunni sahih-ul-aqeedah ko namaz parhne ki ijazat nahin hai bid'ati gumrah aur bad-aqeedah jis ke aqaid bil-khusoos kufr tak pohanche hue hain uski apni namaz nahin hai to uske peeche namaz kaise hogi to kisi bad-aqeedah ke peeche namaz nahin parhni hadees ka mazmoon ye hai ke jo shakhs ye chahta hai ke uski namaz qabool ki jaye to use chahiye ke woh apna imam kisi behtar shakhs ko banaye kyunke tumhare imam tumhare aur tumhare Rab ke darmiyan tumhare numainday hain lihaza kisi bad-aqeedah ke peeche namaz nahin parhni Sunni sahih-ul-aqeedah ke peeche namaz parheinge.

notes: "Mufti Rashid Mahmood Razvi refutes Engineer Muhammad Ali Mirza and Ghair-Muqallid polemicists regarding the manner of descending into prostration (sujud). Razvi shows that physically a camel places its front limbs (hands) down first, cites Ibn al-Qayyim in Zad al-Ma'ad establishing the hadith as 'Maqloob' (inverted text), cites Imam al-Tahawi's correct transmission in Sharh Ma'ani al-Athar, and presents three authentic narrations proving knees before hands: Wa'il ibn Hujr (Tirmidhi 268), Anas ibn Malik (Mustadrak 822), and Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah proving hands-first was abrogated), corroborated by contemporary Saudi scholars including Shaykh Salih al-Fawzan and the practice of the Imams of the Haramain."

And why do both physical zoological observation and leading contemporary Salafi jurists (like Salih al-Fawzan) affirm that camels place their front limbs down first, making descending knees-first the authentic Sunnah practiced by the Prophet (Tirmidhi 268, Mustadrak 822) and the Imams of the Haramain?

notes: "Mufti Rashid Mahmood Razvi refutes Engineer Muhammad Ali Mirza's attacks on Imam Abu Hanifa, specifically Mirza's reliance on Ibn Abi Shaybah's 'Kitab al-Radd ala Abi Hanifa' in al-Musannaf and his claim that Abu Hanifa is a 'notorious personality' multiplied by zero by muhaddithin. Razvi presents Imam Zahid al-Kawthari's rebuttal in al-Nukat al-Tarifah, cites the historical testimony of Imam al-A'mash ('You fuqaha are the physicians, we muhaddithin are the pharmacists'), analyzes parallel disputes (Layth ibn Sa'd's critique of 70 rulings of Imam Malik; Ibn Abi Dhi'b's fatwa against Malik on khiyar al-majlis; Imam Muslim's harsh critique of Bukhari in his Muqaddimah), and establishes the classical rule that peer criticism (kalamu al-aqran) between mujtahids cannot be used to disparage accepted authorities."

[00:12:26] A: Yahi wajah hai ke Imam Muslim rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne Sahih Muslim ke bilkul aaghaz mein riwayat number 92 ke tehat ek masla bayan kiya hai Imam Muslim rahmatullah alayh ne woh masla bayan karte hue Imam Bukhari rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh par tanqeed ki aur itni sakht aur itni karri tanqeed ki ke woh alfaz parh ke aap dekh sakte hain ke Imam Bukhari rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ko mutahaddith kaha Imam Muslim rahmatullah alayh ne aur is baat ko khud Mirza Jhelumi ne tasleem kiya hai ke Imam Muslim ne Imam Bukhari hi ko kaha hai kyun isliye ke Imam Bukhari rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne ek usool banaya us usool ke mutabiq Imam Bukhari ne bohot saari ahadees aur riwayaat ko radd kar diya unko Imam Bukhari ne qabool nahin kiya aur unko za'eef qarar de diya mardood qarar de diya jabke Imam Muslim kehte hain ke ye ahadees in usoolon ki bunyad pe ummat ke a'immah muhadditheen ne qabool kiye hain aap kis bunyad par in hadees ko radd kar rahe hain to Imam Muslim ne Imam Bukhari par sakht tanqeed ki aur sakht alfaz ke sath unke baare mein kalam kiya jis ka zikr karte hue Imam Dhahabi Siyar A'lam al-Nubala ki jild number 12 ke safha number 181 pe likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Siyar A'lam al-Nubala 12/181", phrase_as_heard: "qultu inharrafa Muslimun anil-Bukhari li-hiddati tab'ihi") kehte hain ke Imam Muslim apni hiddat-e-tabee'at ki wajah se unhone Imam Bukhari se inhiraf kar liya aur unko chhor diya na to Imam Bukhari se apni Sahih Muslim mein hadees leke aaye aur na poori Sahih Muslim ke andar unka naam liya hai apni hiddat-e-tab' ki wajah se sunnat ke difa mein.

[00:14:26] A: Ab sawal ye paida hota hai ke Imam Bukhari koi munkir-e-hadees hain ma'adhallah? Woh sunnat ke dushman the ma'adhallah? [00:19:16] A: Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Dhi'b muhaddith ko ye baat pohanchi ke Imam Malik ye hadees [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Hadith: al-bayyi'ani bil-khiyar") is hadees ko woh nahin lete qabool nahin karte to Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Dhi'b jo ke Madinah ke qazi bhi the unhone kaha ke unse tawbah karwayi jaye warna Imam Malik ki gardan ura di jaye ab is par tabsirah karte hue Imam Dhahabi likhte hain qultu main kehta hoon agar woh muttaqi hota jaisa ke bayan kiya gaya hai to aisa qabeeh kalam aise azeem imam ke baare mein na kehte Imam Malik ne is hadees ke zahir par amal nahin kiya kyun kyunke Imam Malik is hadees ko mansookh samajhte the ya ye hai ke Imam Malik is hadees ko qabool karte hain lekin unhone ye jo hadees hai al-bayyi'ani bil-khiyar ma lam yatafarraqa is hadees mein tafarruq se tafarruq-e-abdan murad nahin lete balki Imam Malik tafarruq-e-aqwal murad lete hain aur yahi Imam-e-Azam Abu Hanifa rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ka mauqif hai is hadees ke baare mein ke yahan tafarruq-e-abdan murad nahin hai balki tafarruq-e-aqwal murad hai Imam Malik mujtahid the faqeeh the unhone is hadees mein ijtihad kiya to Imam Dhahabi ne Imam Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Dhi'b par tanqeed kar di sakht lafzon ke andar tanqeed ki ke aisa qabeeh kalam aise azeem imam ke baare mein jabke woh hadees ke andar Imam Malik rahmatullah alayh woh ijtihad kar rahe the.

[00:22:39] A: Bi-hamdillahi ta'ala Imam-e-Azam Abu Hanifa Nu'man ibn Thabit radiyallahu ta'ala anhu jo ke faqeeh hain mujtahid hain ummat ke itne bare imam hain unka manhaj kitni kitabon ke andar maujood hai Hafiz Ibn Abd al-Barr Andalusi ne al-Intiqa' ke andar zikr kiya ke Imam-e-Azam Abu Hanifa rahmatullah alayh farmate hain main sabse pehle masla Allah ki kitab Quran se leta hoon agar Quran se na milay to main Sunnat-e-Rasool se leta hoon agar Sunnat-e-Rasool se na milay to main Nabi Kareem alayhis salatu was salam ke Sahaba mein se kisi sahabi ke qaul ko leta hoon aur agar sahabi ka qaul nahin milta to phir jab baat tabi'een tak aati hai hum rijalun wa nahnu rijal woh bhi rijal hain aur hum bhi rijal hain main masla jo hai phir apne ijtihad se bayan karta hoon.

[00:01:24] A: Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam ka khutbah Hajjat-ul-Wada jo ke Mirza Jhelumi bayan bhi karta rehta hai ke Allah ke Nabi ne Hajjat-ul-Wada ke mauqe par irshad farmaya ke main tumhein do cheezein chhor ke ja raha hoon Allah ki kitab aur uske Nabi ki sunnat ab Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ne ye farmaya ke Allah ki kitab chhor ke ja raha hoon aur Allah ke Nabi ki sunnat yani apni sunnat chhor ke ja raha hoon Huzoor ne ye to nahin farmaya ke main Kitabullah aur Bukhari Muslim chhor ke ja raha hoon kahin hadees mein zikr maujood hai ke tumne jab sunnat lena hai to Bukhari Muslim hi se akhaz karna hai baqi baad ki kitab ya us se pehle ki kitab ko chhor dena hai?

[00:02:11] A: Acha mazay ki baat ye ke ye jo hadees hai ye khud hadees Bukhari Muslim mein maujood nahin hai na Bukhari na Muslim ye hadees Imam Malik ki al-Muwatta mein balaghatan Imam Malik se aur al-Mustadrak alas-Sahihayn Imam Hakim ne hadees number 320 aur ek doosre nuskhe ke mutabiq 318 number ye hadees zikr ki hai ab ye hadees khud Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein maujood nahin Kutub-e-Sittah mein maujood nahin hai jo ke hujjiat-e-hadees ki ek daleel hai jis ki bunyad par hum baat karte hain Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Huzoor ne to sunnat ka zikr kiya Bukhari Muslim ka zikr nahin kiya ab ye kahega ke Bukhari Muslim mein sunnat hi to hai to bhai Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein sunnat hi hai to kya sunnat mahsoor hai Bukhari Muslim ke andar ke jo Bukhari Muslim mein hadees nahin hai woh sunnat nahin hai? Ya Bukhari Muslim se pehle jo kitabein likhi ja chuki hain Muwatta Imam Muhammad hai Muwatta Imam Malik hai Musannaf Abdur Razzaq hai Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal hai Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah hai ye saari kitabein jo Bukhari Muslim se pehle likhi ja chuki hain kya ye koi zabt aur qanoon Quran o Sunnat se iska koi saboot milta hai ke aapne sunnat ko akhaz karne ke liye Bukhari Muslim se hawala pesh karna hai otherwise Bukhari Muslim ke baad agar uske alawa pesh kareinge ya sunnat ka saboot pesh kareinge to woh sunnat nahin manegi woh hadees nahin manegi ye ek ahmakana iska mutaliba hai jis ka Kitab o Sunnat se koi ta'alluq nahin hai.

[00:04:45] A: Misal ke taur par Sahih Bukhari mein Imam Bukhari ne chaar maqamaat pe do Sahaba se hadees ko bayan kiya hai 224, 225, 226 aur 2471 number ahadees hain ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ke do Sahaba bayan karte hain ke Nabi alayhis salatu was salam ne kharay hoke peshab kiya [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari 224", phrase_as_heard: "wa bala qa'iman") aapne kharay hoke peshab farmaya aur aapne baad mein wuzu farmaya ab ye chaar ahadees hain Sahih Bukhari mein aur Sahih Muslim mein do Sahaba se maujood hain kharay hoke peshab karne ki na Bukhari mein na Muslim mein baith ke peshab karne ki ek bhi hadees maujood nahin na Bukhari mein hai na Muslim mein to kya kharay hokar peshab karne ko sunnat qarar de diya jaye aur inhi ahadees ke mutabiq faisla karke ye kaha jaye ke kharay hoke peshab karna sunnat hai?

[00:05:45] A: Nahin aage chaleinge jab hum deegar ahadees ko utha kar dekhte hain to Jami at-Tirmidhi mein Imam Tirmidhi rahimahullah hadees number 12 leke aaye Sayyidah Aisha Siddiqah radiyallahu ta'ala anha se woh farmati hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Jami at-Tirmidhi 12", phrase_as_heard: "man haddathakum annan-Nabiyya bala qa'iman fa-la tusaddiqooh") jo shakhs tumhein ye bayan kare ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne kharay hoke peshab kiya uski tasdeeq na karna Huzoor ne hamesha baith kar peshab farmaya ab sunnat kya hai Sayyidah Aisha radiyallahu ta'ala anha ki hadees se mafhoom ho rahi hai to woh jo Bukhari Muslim ke andar chaar ahadees hain unka kya kareinge? Unki taujeehaat muhadditheen ne ki hain aath taujeehaat uski bayan keen aath taujeehaat baaz ne kaha ke ye ahadees aur ye amal mansookh hai baaz ne kaha ke woh marjooh hai aur Sayyidah Aisha ki hadees rajih hai baaz ne ye kaha hai ke woh kisi illat aur uzr ki bina par us par mahmool kiya jayega agarche taqreeban aath taujeehaat fuqaha ne iski farmayi hain ke woh jo chaar ahadees Bukhari Muslim ki maujood hain kharay peshab karne ki unko sunnat qarar nahin diya kisi uzr ki wajah se kisi illat ki wajah se kisi haraj ki wajah se woh amal hua hai woh amal Nabi Kareem alayhis salatu was salam ki sunnat nahin hai ab Mirza Jhelumi jo hai woh sirf apne us mauqif ko defend karne ke liye itna jur'at-mand bay-baak ho chuka hai ke woh kehta hai kharay hoke peshab karna sunnat hai.

[00:08:00] A: Iske sath doosri misal le lein Sahih Bukhari mein 5615, 5616 aur 5617 teen ahadees Imam Bukhari leke aaye Sayyiduna Maula Ali se aur Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma do Sahaba se ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne kharay hoke pani piya ye Sahih Bukhari mein teen ahadees hain Imam Bukhari leke aaye ab kharay hokar pani peena sunnat hai ya ke deegar ahadees ko hum dekheinge? To Imam Muslim ne teen Sahaba se Sahih Muslim ke andar hadees number 5275 se lekar 5279 tak Anas ibn Malik Abu Sa'id al-Khudri aur Abu Hurairah radiyallahu ta'ala anhum se musalsal ahadees hain ke Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ne kharay hoke pani peene se mana farmaya Huzoor ne kharay hoke pani peene se roka aur yahan tak farmaya ke jo kharay hoke kha pee le use chahiye ke woh qay kar de.

[00:10:05] A: Ye ek jo Mirza dhoka deta hai ke aap apni namaz ka tareeqa Bukhari Muslim se sabit karein Quran o Sunnat ka ye koi usool nahin hai Imam Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ki kitab Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah ye 235 mein faut hue hain ye woh a'immah hain jo Imam Bukhari Muslim se pehle hain to ye saari kitabein kya mansookh ho gayin Bukhari Muslim ke likhe jaane ke baad?

[00:11:28] A: Phir doosra dhoka Mirza Jhelumi ye deta hai ke ye jo tark-e-raf-ul-yadain karne wale hain unhone jo raf-ul-yadain chhorha tha woh sust ho chuke the susteen ki wajah se unhone chhorha tha na'udhubillahi ta'ala ye kehta hai ke mere bayan karne se raf-ul-yadain farz ho chuka hai aur Sahaba-e-Kiram se deen seekhne wale Sahaba-e-Kiram se namaz seekhne wale unke andar itni susti thi ke unhone susti ki wajah se sunnat ko chhor diya na'udhubillahi ta'ala jabke haqeeqat ye hai ke jin Sahaba se tabi'een ne namaz seekhi hai woh Sahaba khud raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the.

[00:12:15] A: Imam Tirmidhi rahmatullah 257 number hadees Sayyiduna Abdullah ibn Mas'ud radiyallahu ta'ala anhu se bayan ki to bayan karne ke baad neeche Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees ke neeche likhte hain ke Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees hasan hai [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Jami at-Tirmidhi under 257", phrase_as_heard: "wa-bihi yaqoolu ghayru wahidin min ashabi-n-Nabi") farmate hain Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees ke mutabiq isi tareeqay ko Nabi Kareem alayhis salam ke ahl-e-ilm Sahaba ne liya hai ahl-e-ilm Sahaba ne yahi tareeqa akhaz kiya hai ke woh shuru namaz ke alawa raf-ul-yadain nahin karte ye Imam Tirmidhi ki gawahi hai na sirf ahl-e-ilm Sahaba balki ahl-e-ilm tabi'een bhi Imam Sufyan Thawri bhi aur Ahl-e-Kufa aur saare ke saare namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi maqamaat pe raf-ul-yadain nahin karte.

[00:13:22] A: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah ke andar Imam Ibn Abi Shaybah hadees lekar aaye hadees number 2469 ke upar kalam karte hue Imam Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Salamah al-Tahawi ne likha hai ke iski sanad sahih hai Sayyiduna Umar Farooq khalifah-e-rashid ke hawale se Aswad tabi'i kehte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 2469", phrase_as_heard: "sallaytu ma'a Umara fa-lam yarfa yadayhi") maine Hazrat Umar ke peeche namaz parhi Hazrat Umar namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi maqam par raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the shuru namaz mein Allahu Akbar kehke raf-ul-yadain karte the baqi namaz mein nahin karte the.

[00:14:26] A: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah mein 2457 number Imam Ibn Abi Shaybah hadees leke aaye Sayyiduna Maula Ali radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke shagird Kulayb bin Shihab kehte hain ke Maula Ali jab namaz parhte to namaz ke shuru mein to apne haathon ko uthate the [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 2457", phrase_as_heard: "thumma la ya'oodu") phir poori namaz mein dobara raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the is hadees par tabsirah karte hue Imam Jamaluddin Zayla'i bohot bare azeem muhaddith Nasb al-Raya ki pehli jild safha 408 pe likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Nasb al-Raya 1/408", phrase_as_heard: "wa huwa atharun sahihun") Imam Zayla'i kehte hain ye asar sahih hai.

[00:15:28] A: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma ke hawale se 2467 number riwayat leke aaye Imam Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah Mujahid tabi'i jo ke Abdullah bin Umar ke shagird hain woh kehte hain maine Abdullah bin Umar ko namaz parhte dekha woh namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi namaz mein raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the Imam Badruddin Ayni Umdat al-Qari Sharh Sahih al-Bukhari jild number 5 safha number 399 pe likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Umdat al-Qari 5/399", phrase_as_heard: "rawahu bi-isnadin sahihin") is hadees ko Imam Tahawi ne bhi Sharh Ma'ani al-Athar mein zikr kiya hai aur ye sanad-e-sahih ke sath ye hadees hai Abdullah bin Umar radiyallahu ta'ala anhu raf-ul-yadain nahin kar rahe Sayyiduna Umar Farooq khalifah-e-rashid Maula Ali raf-ul-yadain nahin kar rahe.

[00:16:45] A: Imam Sha'bi 500 Sahaba ki ziyarat karne wale imam hain Imam Sha'bi ke hawale se Imam Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne 2459 number hadees zikr ki hai ke Imam Sha'bi jaleel-ul-qadr tabi'i woh bhi namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi maqam par raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the iske alawa Abu Ishaq tabi'i kehte hain Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 2461 number riwayat hai ke jinhone namaz Maula Ali se seekhi jinhone namaz Abdullah bin Mas'ud radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma dono Sahaba se seekhi woh tabi'een aur Maula Ali aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke shagird namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi maqam pe raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the aur Mirza kya kehta hai susti ki wajah se chhor diya tha? Susti ki wajah se nahin chhor diya tha isliye woh raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the ke unhone namaz Maula Ali se aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se seekhi thi aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud aur Maula Ali dono namaz ke shuru ke alawa aakhiri waqt tak baqi maqamat par raf-ul-yadain nahin karte the.

[00:27:04] A: Aur iske alawa Mirza Jhelumi ek aur dhoka ye deta hai ke siwaye Hanafiyon ke baqi saari ummat unka mauqif yahi hai ke namaz mein raf-ul-yadain karna hai jabke Mirza Jhelumi ka ye bilkul jhoot hai ummat ke jo bare chaar imam hain un mein se do bare imam Imam-e-Azam Abu Hanifa aur Imam Malik dono ka mauqif ye hai ke namaz ke andar shuru ke alawa raf-ul-yadain nahin hai Imam-e-Abu Hanifa ka to bilkul wazeh hai isme to hawala pesh karne ki bhi zaroorat nahin hai aur Imam Malik rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ka mauqif unki fiqh ki jo mo'tabar kitab jisko Mirza Jhelumi mo'tabar aur mustanad tasleem kar chuka hai ye al-Mudawwanah al-Kubra Maliki fiqh ki bunyadi kitab kaun si hai al-Mudawwanah al-Kubra iske upar poori fiqh-e-Maliki base karti hai iske andar Imam Malik ka mauqif bilkul do-took andaz mein pehli jild ke safha 118 mein maujood hai [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Mudawwanah al-Kubra 1/118", phrase_as_heard: "la a'rifu raf'al-yadayni fee shay'in min takbeeris-salat illa fee iftitahis-salat") Imam Malik kehte hain namaz ke shuru ke alawa baqi maqam pe raf-ul-yadain karne ko main jaanta hi nahin hoon [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Mudawwanah 1/118", phrase_as_heard: "wa ra'ful-yadayni inda Malikin da'eefun illa fee takbeeratil-ihram") Imam Malik ke nazdeek takbeerat al-ihram ke alawa baqi maqam pe raf-ul-yadain karna da'eef hai ye Imam Malik ka mauqif likha hai ye al-Mudawwanah al-Kubra jiske baare mein Mirza keh chuka hai ke fiqh-e-Maliki saari ki saari is par khari hai.

[00:30:36] A: Aur phir ek aur dhoka Mirza Jhelumi ye deta hai ke ye kehte hain ke ahadees to hamari bhi hain ahadees to hamari bhi hain lekin inko ye pata nahin inki ahadees ko bayan karke neeche likh diya ke ye hadees za'eef hai to kehta hai shayad ye bhi bataya ke ye hadees za'eef hai ye Mirza Jhelumi ka bilkul wazeh jhoot aur iftira hai Imam Tirmidhi rahmatullah ne Sayyiduna Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees bayan ki 257 number hadees ke neeche ye likha hai ke [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Jami at-Tirmidhi 257", phrase_as_heard: "hadithu Ibn Mas'ud hadithun hasan") Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees hasan hai aur Jami at-Tirmidhi Nasiruddin Albani ki tahkeem ke sath utha ke dekh lein Nasiruddin Albani ne is hadees ko sahih qarar diya aur ye Sunan Abi Dawud hai 748 number hadees Nasiruddin Albani ne is hadees ko sahih qarar diya Nasiruddin Albani ki ek aur kitab hai Sahih Sunan Abi Dawud us par poori tehqeeq ke sath saari detail Nasiruddin Albani ne zikr ki hai aur kaha ke ismein koi shubhah nahin hai ke haq yahi hai ke ye hadees Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadees sahih hai iske alawa Sunan an-Nasa'i ki tehqeeq mein bhi Nasiruddin Albani ne is hadees ko sahih qarar diya hai to ye ahadees bilkul a'immah muhadditheen aur fuqaha ke nazdeek sahih hain.

[00:32:41] A: Aur iske alawa ek aam dhoka jo log usko qabool kar lete hain woh ye hai ke raf-ul-yadain karne ki jo ahadees hain woh zyada hain aur na karne ki kam hain lihaza zyada karne ki hain to uske mutabiq amal kar diya jaye halanke ye koi zabt koi usool nahin hai agar yahi zabt aur usool hai to main aapko ek misal pesh karta hoon Sahih Muslim se Sahih Muslim mein Imam Muslim 3410 number hadees se lekar 3435 number hadees tak Mut'ah ke hawale se ahadees leke aaye hain taqreeban 26 ahadees Imam Muslim ne Sahih Muslim mein zikr ki hain Mut'at an-Nisa ke hawale se 26 ahadees ko zikr kiya hai zyada karne ki jawaz ki hain aur kam na karne ki hain to kya zyada karne ki hain to karna shuru kar dein? Hargiz nahin humne dekhna hai ke rajih kaun si ahadees hain matrook aur mansookh kaun si hain aur baad wali nasikh aur rajih kaun si hain mutabiq unke amal hoga jo rajih aur nasikh hain na ke mansookh aur matrook.

### New Counter-Question Themes Registered

- CQ-33 (Bukhari-Muslim Exclusivity / Urinating Standing & Drinking Standing): If an action is only Sunnah if found in Sahih Bukhari and Muslim, why does Bukhari contain 4 narrations of the Prophet urinating standing and zero of sitting, while the Ummah acts upon Aisha's narration in Tirmidhi (12) that he only urinated sitting? And why does Bukhari contain 3 narrations of the Prophet drinking while standing, while Sahih Muslim strictly forbids it? If text presence in Bukhari does not make standing urination mandatory Sunnah, why impose this arbitrary filter on prayer?

- CQ-34 (Turnabout on Imam Malik & al-Mudawwanah / 4 Raf al-Yadayn Consensus Myth): When opponents claim that all 4 Sunni Madhhabs and all sects agree on 4 raf al-yadayn except Hanafis, why do they conceal the explicit ruling of Imam Malik in his primary foundational work al-Mudawwanah al-Kubra (1/118): "I do not know of raising hands in any part of prayer... and raising hands according to Malik is da'eef except at takbeerat al-ihram"?

- CQ-35 (Narration Counting vs Naskh / The 26 Mut'ah Hadiths in Sahih Muslim): If a legal ruling is decided simply by which position has more numerous narrations, why does the Ummah unanimously prohibit Mut'ah (temporary marriage) when Sahih Muslim contains 26 narrations permitting it (3410–3435) and far fewer prohibiting it? If earlier permissible narrations were abrogated (mansookh) regardless of their count, why dismiss abrogation (naskh) in the case of raf al-yadayn?

[ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Tarikh Dimashq 59/132, Fath al-Bari", phrase_as_heard: "fa-qala Muawiyatu la wallahi") hargiz nahin Allah ki qasam aise nahin hai main jaanta hoon ke Ali mujh se afzal hain aur Hazrat Ali radiyallahu ta'ala anhu woh is amr ke is mamle ke mujh se zyada haqdar hain.

[00:05:14] A: Aala Hazrat Imam-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Muhaddith Barelvi rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne Fatawa Razawiyyah shareef ki jild number 29 safha number 377 pe likha hai rahe Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu to unka darjah in sab ke baad hai aur Hazrat Mola Ali radiyallahu anhu ke maqaam-e-rafee' o shaan-e-manee' tak to unse woh door-daraz manzilein hain jin hazaron hazar rahwar barq-kirdar saba-raftar thak rahein aur qata' na kar sakein aur jild number 10 safha number uske 201 pe likhte hain bil-jumlah hum ahl-e-haq ke nazdeek Hazrat Imam Bukhari ko Huzoor Purnoor Imam-e-Azam se wohi nisbat hai jo Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ko Huzoor Purnoor Ameer-ul-Momineen Mola al-Muslimeen Sayyiduna wa Maulana Ali al-Murtaza karramallahu ta'ala wajhahul kareem se hai ke farq-e-maratib be-shumar aur haq badast-e-Haydar-e-Karrar magar Muawiyah bhi hamare sardar ta'n un par bhi kar-e-fujjar jo Muawiyah ki himayat mein iyadhan billah Asadullah ke sabqat o awwaliyat o azmat o akmaliyat se aankh pher le woh Nasibi Yazidi aur jo Ali ki muhabbat mein Muawiyah ki sahabiyat o nisbat-e-bargah-e-Hazrat-e-Risalat bhula de woh Shi'i Zaidi yahi ravish-e-adab bi-hamdillahi ta'ala hum ahl-e-tawassut o i'tidal ko har jagah malhooz rehti hai.

[00:06:58] A: Aur doosra masla Tahir-ul-Qadri sahab ne jo baat ki hai ke Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu tulaqa mein se hain pehli baat to ye ke ala sabeel al-tanazzul agar is baat ko tasleem kar liya jaye ke woh Fath-e-Makkah ke mauqe par Islam unhone qabool kiya aur woh tulaqa mein se hain to kya tulaqa mein se hona ye kisi ki sahabiyat ke munafi hai? Jo Fath-e-Makkah ke mauqe par Musalman hue kya woh Musalman hone wale Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam ki sahabiyat ke sharaf se musharraf nahin hue? Surah al-Hadid ki aayat number 10 ke andar Allah Rabbul Izzat ne Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ke Sahaba ke un do girohon jo Fath-e-Makkah se pehle aur jo Fath-e-Makkah ke baad Islam qabool karke Allah Rabbul Izzat ki bargah mein woh kharch karte hain aur maidan-e-jihad mein nikal ke Allah ki rah mein larte hain unke liye Quran-e-Majeed mein irshad farma diya [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Surah Al-Hadid 57:10", phrase_as_heard: "wa kullan wa'adallahu al-husna") Allah Rabbul Izzat ne tamam ke sath husna ka wa'dah farma liya to Sayyiduna Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ko agar Fath-e-Makkah ke mauqe par bhi unka Islam mana jaye tab bhi sharaf-e-sahabiyat se musharraf hain.

[00:08:20] A: Aur khud Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu bayan karte hain Sahih Bukhari ke andar hadees maujood hai farmate hain humne Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ki suhbat paayi hai aur phir Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abbas radiyallahu ta'ala anhuma se Sahih Bukhari ke andar riwayat maujood hai Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abbas farmate hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sahih Bukhari", phrase_as_heard: "innahu sahiba Rasulallah") Ameer Muawiyah ko chhor do woh Rasoolullah sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam ke sahabi hain to Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu sahabi hain aur sahabiyat ka sharaf unhein hasil hai ab reh gaya masla ke unka Islam qabool karna kab hai to is mauqe par unka apna bayan kya?

[00:09:14] A: Imam Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Abi Khaythama apni kitab al-Tarikh al-Kabir jise Tarikh Ibn Abi Khaythama kaha jaata hai usmein jild number 1 ke safha number 544 pe Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ka apna qaul zikr karte hain farmate hain ke main Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa sallam ki bargah-e-aqdas mein jis saal aap alayhis salatu was salam ne Umrah al-Qada kiya us saal Huzoor ki bargah mein hazir hua maine Islam qabool kiya Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam se mulaqat ki maine apna Islam jo hai woh Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ki bargah mein pesh kiya to Allah ke Rasool alayhis salatu was salam ne mujh se Islam qabool kar liya aur ye baat Imam Nawawi ne apni kitab Tahdhib al-Asma wal-Lughat ki jild number 2 safha number 406 pe bayan ki aur al-Isabah Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ki usmein bhi Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne is baat ko zikr kiya hai Sayyiduna Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu khud bayan karte hain ke Fath-e-Makkah se pehle woh Islam qabool kar chuke the haan izhar jo hai woh Fath-e-Makkah ke mauqe par unhone kiya.

[00:11:15] A: Ye Sharh Sahih Muslim hai Imam Nawawi rahmatullah alayh ki jild number 15 ke safha number 149 pe likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Sharh Sahih Muslim 15/149", phrase_as_heard: "Muawiyatu huwa min fudalai-sahaba") ke Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ye fudala aur nujaba Sahaba alayhimur ridwan ke andar unka shumar hota hai ab Tahir-ul-Qadri sahab ka ye kehna ke hamare a'immah ne to Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke hawale se sukoot kiya hai ke bus unko sab-o-shatam na kiya jaye unko kafir na kaha jaye aur unko fasiq na kaha jaye ye jo aaj logon ne shuru kar liya ke unke faza'il bayan karte hain ye kahan likha hai aur kis aqeeday ki kitab ke andar unke faza'il ke chapters aur abwab qayam kiye gaye hain?

[00:12:56] A: Pehli baat ye hai ke aqeeday ki kitabon ke andar faza'il ke aur manaqib ke chapters aur abwab nahin hote bil-umoom aqeeday ki kitabon ke andar aqaid bayan hote hain albattah baaz ulama ne aqeeday ki kitabon ke andar bhi aur bohot saare a'immah muhadditheen ne seerat faza'il aur ahadees ki kitabon ke andar Sayyiduna Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke faza'il ke upar ba-qa'idah chapters aur abwab qayam kiye hain main aapke samne chand hawalajaat pesh kar deta hoon ye Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ki kitab hai Fada'il al-Sahaba usmein Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal ne poora chapter aur baab qayam kiya hai Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu anhu ke faza'il ke hawale se ye kutub-e-ahadees mein se mashhoor kitab hai Jami at-Tirmidhi Imam Tirmidhi rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne Sayyiduna Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke faza'il ke upar poora baab qayam kiya hai Kitab al-Manaqib Jami at-Tirmidhi ke andar Manaqib Muawiyah ibn Abi Sufyan radiyallahu ta'ala anhu iske alawa Hafiz Hibatullah al-Lalaka'i Sharh Usul I'tiqad Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah usmein Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke faza'il ke hawale se unhone ek unwan qayam kiya hai baab qayam kiya hai.

[00:14:43] A: Aur reh gayi baat ye ke unke baare mein sukoot kiya jaye aur unki fazilat bayan na ki jaye a'immah muhadditheen aur hamare jo aslaaf hain unhone Sahaba-e-Kiram radiyallahu ta'ala anhum ke mushajarat ke baare mein to sukoot ka hukum diya hai lekin unke faza'il aur manaqib bayan karne ke baare mein koi sukoot wali baat nahin balki ye kaha hai ke Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at is par muttafiq hain ke unke faza'il bayan kiye jayein aur unke manaqib bayan kiye jayein waise Tahir-ul-Qadri sahab kehte hain ke main sag-e-Ghaus-e-Azam hoon main Sheikh Abdul Qadir Jilani rahmatullah alayh ka sag hoon Sheikh Abdul Qadir Jilani Ghaus-e-Pak Sarkar rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh ne apni kitab Ghunyat al-Talibeen ki jild number 1 safha number 163 pe yahi aqeedah likha hai ke hamara Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka mushajarat-e-sahaba mein kya nazriyah hai farmate hain Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at is baat par muttafiq hain ke apni zabanon ko Sahaba ke mushajarat ke baare mein rok ke rakha jaye aur unki burayi bayan karne se ruk jaaya jaye to phir kya kiya jaye? [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Ghunyat al-Talibeen 1/163", phrase_as_heard: "wa-ittafaqoo ala izhari fada'ilihim wa mahasinihim") haan is baat par bhi muttafiq hain ke Sahaba-e-Kiram radiyallahu ta'ala anhum ke faza'il aur unki khoobiyan aur unke mahasin ka izhar kiya jaye aur jo kuch ho chuka hai uske baare mein unke mamlaat ko Allah ke supurd kar diya jaye.

[00:16:55] A: Isi tarah ek aur hawala Imam Ibn Abi Zamanin ki kitab Kitab Usul al-Sunnah jild number 2 safha number 850 pe likhte hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "Kitab Usul al-Sunnah 2/850", phrase_as_heard: "wa-nashri mahasinihim wa fada'ilihim") aur Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka ye qaul hai ke aadmi Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salam ke Sahaba ki muhabbat ka i'tiqad rakkhe aur unki khoobiyon ko nashr kare unke mahasin ko nashr kare phailaye aur unki fazilaton ko aagay phailaye logon tak pohanchaye aur jo unke darmiyan ho chuka hai usmein ghaur-o-khauz karne se apne aap ko rokay rakkhe aur ye Imam Qadi Iyad Maliki rahmatullah alayh ki kitab al-Shifa bi-Ta'rif Huquq al-Mustafa sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam safha 55 hai doosri jild ka Imam Qadi Iyad likhte hain Nabi-e-Pak alayhis salatu was salam ki ta'zeem o tawqeer mein se ye hai ke Nabi-e-Pak ke Sahaba ki tawqeer aur ta'zeem ki jaye unki achhe tareeqay se tareef ki jaye unki khoobiyan bayan ki jayein aur unke darmiyan jo aapas mein ikhtilafat hue usmein apni zabanon ko rok liya jaye aur unke darmiyan jo kuch lara'iyan aur jo kuch aapas mein unke mushajarat hue unki behtar se behtar ta'weel talash ki jaye aur unka kisi ek ka bhi burayi ke sath zikr na kiya jaye balki Sahaba-e-Kiram ke faza'il unki khoobiyan unka zikr kiya jaye.

[00:24:16] A: Phir Tahir-ul-Qadri sahab ne ye bhi kaha ke Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at 1300 saal ke andar kisi ne aisa nahin likha ke Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu ta'ala anhu ke hawale se kisi ne ye kaha ho ke woh bhi sahabi hain aur Hazrat Ali bhi sahabi hain aur unke darmiyan jo hua dono durustagi par hain pehli baat to ye samajh lein ke hamara Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka jumhoor ka nazriyah aur aqeedah ye hai ke Sayyiduna Mola Ali radiyallahu ta'ala anhu apni tamam haroob aur jangon ke andar museeb bar-haq the aur aapka ijtihad hi woh durust tha museeb tha aur muqable mein aane wale ijtihadi khata par the ye hamare Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka jumhoor ka mauqif hai lekin iske alawa bhi Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne ek baat ki hai Fath al-Bari Sharh Sahih al-Bukhari ki jild number 13 safha number 83 se Imam Ibn Hajar likhte hain farmate hain jumhoor Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at is taraf gaye hain ke jo Mola Ali ke sath the woh durustagi par hain aur is baat par bhi muttafiq hain ke Mola Ali ka giroh aur muqable mein jo Jamal aur Siffin ke andar aaye un mein se kisi ek ki mazammat nahin ki jayegi balki woh ye kehte hain ke unhone ijtihad kiya aur ijtihad mein khata kar baithe aur Ahl-e-Sunnat hi mein ek chhota sa giroh ek ta'ifah qaleelah woh is taraf gaye hain aur ek ismein kaseer Mu'tazilah ka bhi qaul hai ke dono giroh jo hain woh durustagi par the.

[00:27:45] A: Isi tareeqay se Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari rahmatullahi ta'ala alayh apni kitab al-Ibanah an Usul al-Diyanah safha number 624 aur 625 par likhte hain farmate hain ke jo Sayyiduna Mola Ali Hazrat Talha Zubayr aur Hazrat Aisha Siddiqah radiyallahu ta'ala anhum ke mabayn hua woh ta'weel aur ijtihad ki bunyad pe tha aur Nabi-e-Pak sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi wa sallam ne un sab ke liye jannat ki Huzoor ne gawahi ata farmayi Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari rahmatullah alayh farmate hain [ARABIC RECITATION] (speaker says: "al-Ibanah an Usul al-Diyanah pp. 624-625", phrase_as_heard: "kulluhum kanoo ala haqqin fee ijtihadihim") ye saare ke saare apne ijtihad mein haq par the jumhoor ka mauqif ye hai ke Mola Ali museeb the aur muqable mein aane wale ijtihadi khata par the lekin Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari ka qaul jo al-Ibanah an Usul al-Diyanah ke andar hai aur Imam Ibn Hajar Asqalani ne Fath al-Bari ke andar iski tafseel bayan kar di to is se ye baat bilkul ayaan aur wazeh ho jaati hai ke Tahir-ul-Qadri sahab jo hain woh in mamlaat ke andar kis tareeqe se cheezon ko bayan karte hain aur kis tarah ke blunder maar ke woh ye sabit karne ki koshish karte hain ke Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah radiyallahu anhu ke faza'il aur manaqib bayan nahin karne sirf unke baare mein sukoot karna hai jabke a'immah-e-deen ne likha hai ke unke baare mein burayi bayan karne se sukoot karna hai haan wa izhari fada'ilihim Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at muttafiq hain ke unke faza'il bayan kiye jayeinge aur unki khoobiyon ko bayan kiya jayega.
```

### 1. Repository Directory Structure

```plaintext
dalail-debate-corpus/
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── validate.yml               # Automated CI validation workflow
├── schema/
│   ├── source.schema.json             # JSON Schema for video metadata & transcripts
│   └── extraction.schema.json         # JSON Schema for debate moves & argument nodes
├── data/

│   ├── counter-questions/
│   │   └── master_counter_questions.yaml # Complete CQ-01 to CQ-40 catalog
│   ├── sources/                       # 46 Markdown transcripts (yt-<id>.md)
│   └── extractions/                   # 46 Structured YAML extractions (yt-<id>.yaml)
├── scripts/
│   ├── validate_corpus.py             # Integrity & schema validation script
│   └── generate_graph.py              # Compiles YAML nodes into app-ready graph JSON
├── docs/
│   ├── taxonomy.md                    # Prefix definitions & move types
│   └── contributing.md                # Transcription & evidence capture guidelines
├── LICENSE                            # MIT or CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0
└── README.md                          # Repository landing page
```

### 5. Automated Integrity Validation Script

Save this script to scripts/validate_corpus.py. You can run it locally or via GitHub Actions:

```python
import os
import yaml
import json
import sys

def run_validation():
    base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    print(f"Validating Dalail Debate Corpus at: {base_dir}")
    errors = []
    
    # 1. Validate Schemas
    for sf in ["source.schema.json", "extraction.schema.json"]:
        p = os.path.join(base_dir, "schema", sf)
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            errors.append(f"Missing schema: {sf}")
        else:
            try:
                with open(p) as f:
                    json.load(f)
                print(f" [PASS] Schema JSON valid: {sf}")
            except Exception as e:
                errors.append(f"Invalid JSON in schema {sf}: {str(e)}")
                
    # 2. Validate Counter-Questions
    cq_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "data", "counter-questions", "master_counter_questions.yaml")
    if not os.path.exists(cq_path):
        errors.append(f"Missing counter-questions file: {cq_path}")
    else:
        try:
            with open(cq_path) as f:
                cqs = yaml.safe_load(f).get("counter_questions", {})
            assert len(cqs) == 40, f"Expected 40 CQs, found {len(cqs)}"
            print(f" [PASS] Counter-Questions: 40 verified (CQ-01 to CQ-40)")
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append(f"Error in counter questions: {str(e)}")
            
    # 3. Validate Claims Registry
    claims_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "data", "claims", "master_claims_registry.yaml")
    if not os.path.exists(claims_path):
        errors.append(f"Missing claims file: {claims_path}")
    else:
        try:
            with open(claims_path) as f:
                claims = yaml.safe_load(f).get("claims", {})
            print(f" [PASS] Claims Registry: {len(claims)} standardized claims verified.")
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append(f"Error in claims registry: {str(e)}")
            
    # 4. Validate Master Registry
    reg_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "data", "master_registry_v4.yaml")
    if not os.path.exists(reg_path):
        errors.append(f"Missing master registry: {reg_path}")
    else:
        try:
            with open(reg_path) as f:
                reg = yaml.safe_load(f)
            v_count = reg.get("total_videos_processed", 0)
            assert v_count == 46, f"Expected 46 catalogued videos, found {v_count}"
            print(f" [PASS] Master Registry: 46 videos indexed with valid node mappings.")
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append(f"Error in master registry: {str(e)}")

    if errors:
        print("\nValidation Failed:")
        for err in errors:
            print(f" - {err}")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        print("\nAll validation checks passed successfully! Corpus is ready for GitHub.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_validation()
```

### 6. GitHub Actions CI Workflow

Save this file to .github/workflows/validate.yml so that GitHub automatically verifies the integrity of any new pull requests:

```yaml
name: Validate Dalail Debate Corpus

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyyaml jsonschema

      - name: Run Integrity Validation
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_corpus.py
```
